Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

The Service Technician at Nextran Truck Centers is a skilled position that is responsible for repairing and maintaining our customers’ Medium & Heavy-Duty Trucks. This includes preventative maintenance, repairs, disassembly, and reassembly, and writing detailed work notes.

Essential Duties:

Performs work as outlined on the repair order with efficiency and accuracy, in accordance with dealership and factory standards.
  • Diagnose the cause of the malfunctions and perform repairs.
  • Communicates with the parts department to obtain needed parts.
  • Saves and tags parts of the job if under warranty or if requested by the customer.
  • Documents all work performed and recommended on the repair order.
  • Reports machinery defects or malfunctions to the supervisor.
  • Ensures that the vehicle is kept clean. Notifies the service advisor/dispatcher immediately of anything that has happened to change the appearance or condition of the vehicle.
  • Maintains and is accountable for all dealership-owned tools and manuals. Returns all tools and manuals to the proper place and in the same condition as when they were received.
  • Understands, keeps abreast of, and complies with federal, state, and local regulations, such as hazardous waste disposal, OSHA Right-to-Know, etc. Keeps abreast of manufacturer technical bulletins.
  • Operates all tools/equipment in a safe manner and reports any safety issues immediately to management.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Two plus years of diesel mechanic experience.
  • ASE or Cummins Engine Repair Certificate is a plus.
  • English proficiency is essential for understanding safety protocols, customer interactions, and internal communications.
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid CDL License a plus, recommended within 1 year of hiring.

Mathematical Skills:

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, percentage, draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability:

Ability to solve problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations with only limited resources.Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms.
  • Use of torque wrenches, air powered tools or hand tools.
  • Use of arms in a raised position above shoulder level for prolong periods of time. Use of creeper or rolling device to enable tech to work underneath vehicle.
  • The employee frequently is required to walk; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear.
  • The employee is required to stand and sit for extended periods of time (hours) while making repairs.
  • Entry or exit from the cab of the vehicle.
  • Climb to a safe position to access the engine compartment area, firewall or roof of a vehicle to perform repairs.
  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Ability to push/pull large tool chest from vehicle to vehicle.

Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers Mobile Diesel Mechanic - Orlando, Florida

Join a team that brings the shop to the customer. Are you an experienced diesel technician looking for something different? Do you enjoy building relationships, solving problems, and working directly with customers rather than spending every day in the same service bay?

Nextran Truck Centers is hiring! Our Employees Benefit from:

Career Paths || Network of 30 Dealerships || Disability Insurance || Paid Time Off (2wks 1st year) || Nextran Paid Life Insurance

Family Centered Values || Medical and Dependent Care FSA || 401(k) Retirement Plan with Match || Company-Paid Holidays || EAP

Great Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits || Social Responsibility Opportunities || 28+ Years of Industry Experience || Professional Growth

Summary

As a Mobile Diesel Technician, you will serve as a concierge-style field technician supporting customer fleets on-site. You become an extension of both our dealership and our customers’ operation. Every day brings new challenges and opportunities as you work closely with fleet managers, drivers, and maintenance personnel to keep equipment operating safely and efficiently.

This is not a traditional roadside emergency repair position. Instead, you will serve as a trusted technical resource for our fleet customers, delivering planned maintenance, inspections, upgrades, and repair solutions directly at their locations.

We believe our technicians are among our most valuable assets. In this role, you will not simply repair equipment, you will build lasting relationships with customers and help develop solutions that support their business. You will work directly on customer property, in their maintenance facilities, and in the field, serving as a trusted advisor and representative of our organization.

Essential Duties:

  • Scheduled preventive maintenance services
  • Factory warranty campaigns and recalls
  • Fleet-wide upgrades and retrofits
  • DOT inspections and certifications
  • Windshield replacements
  • Valve adjustments and engine services
  • Diagnostic troubleshooting and repairs
  • Customer consultations and maintenance planning
  • Coordinating transportation of equipment to our dealership service center when major repairs are required.

What We’re Looking For

  • Heavy-duty diesel repair experience
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service abilities
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently
  • Professional appearance and positive attitude
  • Commitment to safety and quality workmanship
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and customer needs

Schedule

This position offers variety and flexibility. Work schedules may vary based on customer requirements and business needs. We strive to accommodate the needs of our team members while maintaining the flexibility necessary to deliver exceptional customer service.

What We Offer

  • Competitive starting pay
  • Performance-based wage growth opportunities
  • Additional compensation opportunities tied to industry certifications
  • Company-provided service truck stocked with tools and inventory
  • Potential authorization to take company vehicle home based on performance and business needs
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to build meaningful customer relationships and make a direct impact

Why Join Us?

If you’re looking for a career where your skills, work ethic, professionalism, and positive attitude are genuinely appreciated, you’ve come to the right place. Join a team that values expertise, invests in its people, and empowers technicians to make a difference every day.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

  • Promote sales by telephone, mail, and email.
  • Keep counter areas clean and uncluttered.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_html:
Nextran Truck Centers Talent Acquisition Partner - Central Florida Region

Nextran Truck Centers is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the workforce that will support our continued growth. Based at our Orlando Florida dealership, this position will initially support talent acquisition efforts across the Central Florida Region, and will report to the corporate Vice President of Human Resources.

This Talent Acquisition Partner goes beyond filling open positions. This individual will work closely with dealership and HR leadership to understand current and future talent needs, build sustainable candidate pipelines, strengthen bench strength, and improve hiring and retention outcomes.

As a new role within Nextran, this position offers the opportunity to help shape and expand our talent acquisition strategy across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with dealership leaders to identify current and future hiring needs and gaps in bench strength.
  • Develop short- and long-term recruiting strategies that support both external hiring and internal talent development.
  • Source, recruit, screen, and help select qualified candidates for skilled trade, operational, sales, leadership, and other dealership positions.
  • Build proactive candidate pipelines for critical and difficult-to-fill roles.
  • Manage the recruiting and hiring process in partnership with Hiring Managers and local HR.
  • Help leaders improve interviewing, candidate assessment, and selection practices.
  • Support the identification and development of high-potential employees for future opportunities.
  • Partner with management on effective onboarding and training plans for new hires and monitor early retention.
  • Develop relationships with technical schools, industry organizations, professional associations, and other talent sources.
  • Leverage recruiting technology, social media, career fairs, marketing, and other creative sourcing strategies.
  • Monitor the competitive talent market and recommend ways for Nextran to remain competitive in attracting and retaining employees.
  • Use recruiting data and analytics to track results, including time-to-fill, source of hire, hiring volume, 90-day retention, and bench strength progress.
  • Partner with dealership leadership, HR Business Partners, and Corporate HR on employee engagement and retention opportunities.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 4 years of Human Resources and/or talent acquisition experience, preferably within a decentralized or multi-location organization.
  • Demonstrated success recruiting and hiring high-quality talent.
  • Experience recruiting skilled trades, technicians, transportation, logistics, supply chain, or other difficult-to-fill operational roles strongly preferred.
  • Strong sourcing, networking, and candidate pipeline development skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and influence leaders across multiple functions.
  • Proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Experience with an ATS and HRIS; ClearCompany and UKG experience is a plus.
  • Staffing agency experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree and SHRM-CP, PHR, or similar certification preferred.
  • Fluency in Spanish is a plus

Why Nextran?

Nextran Truck Centers is a network of 30+ medium and heavy-duty truck dealerships committed to providing the best products and services through highly skilled employees who are focused on delivering the lowest life-cycle cost. Above all, we are dedicated to keeping our customers moving.

This role provides the opportunity to move beyond transactional recruiting and have a direct impact on Nextran's long-term talent strategy. You will help build stronger talent pipelines, develop internal bench strength, expand industry partnerships, and influence how we attract and retain great people.

If you enjoy learning the business, building relationships, finding great talent, and creating sustainable recruiting strategies, we'd like to hear from you.

Nextran Core Hiring Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Instills Trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity
  • Communicates Effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward

Join Nextran and help us build the talent that will drive our future.

Notice Regarding Job Posting Scams

We are aware that fraudulent job postings and recruitment scams are becoming more common. Please be advised that legitimate communications from our company will only come from official company email addresses and through our verified hiring platforms.

We will never ask candidates to provide payment, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information (such as bank account details or Social Security numbers) during the initial application or interview process.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to represent our company, please do not respond or provide any information. Instead, report the communication to us through our official website or apply directly through our verified job postings.

Your safety and privacy are important to us, and we encourage all applicants to remain vigilant when searching for employment opportunities.

EEO Employer

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description_html:
Job Title: Accounts Payable Specialist

Classification: Hourly/Non-Exempt

Reports to: Controller

Department: Accounting

Introduction:

  • The role of the Accounts Payable Specialist is to collect, report, and process all Vendor invoices and pay applications from subcontractors. He/she is to assure accountability, accuracy, and confidentiality of any and all payables related information and to track pay applications, invoices, purchase order receivers and unvouchered liabilities.

Functional Role:

  • The basic function of this position is to manage the smooth flow of Accounts Payable information of the company. To track all invoices and pay applications received and match all purchase order receivers to the appropriate invoices. They are also responsible for coordinating the approval of all subcontractors pay applications with the appropriate Project Manager and to ensure pay applications are posted to accounts payable in the accounting period that they apply to.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for maintaining Insurance certificates for subcontractors ensuring all insurance requirements are at the minimum amounts required by the subcontract and are current with respect to policy expiration dates.
  • Responsible for accurate accounting records of the Company’s Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the close security of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of company Accounts Payable and Vendor records.
  • Keep management apprised of the collection status of past due accounts and lien position within the time requirements that protect all lien rights.
  • Ensure the Accounts Payable documents are processed in a timely and error-free manner.

Requirements:

  • Education: High School diploma with courses in accounting.
  • Experience: Two to five year’s experience in Accounts Payable and AIA Schedule of Values.
  • MUST have lien law knowledge and experience.
  • Skills, knowledge, and abilities - Ability to work independently and to work well with others in a multi-functional fast paced environment. Good comprehension of Accounts Payables, Subcontractor and spreadsheet software, excellent reading, writing and verbal skills. Must understand AIA Schedule Of Values.
  • Reasoning Ability – Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems, ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables, ability to manage a variety of activities simultaneously.
  • Language Skills – Ability to communicate and give answers in a clear and precise style, ability to compose standard letters with proper format, grammar, punctuation, and spelling, using all parts of speech, ability to speak with poise, voice control, and confidence, using correct English with a well modulated voice.
  • Physical – While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to talk on the phone and use a computer.
  • Work Environment - The work is normally performed in a standard office environment with usually quiet to moderate noise levels.

DFWP/EOE

jobs.title: Commercial Service Technician
jobs.description_html:
Responsibilities:

  • Present a positive image to customers, co-workers, and others at all times
  • Follow all service department and company policies and procedures
  • Adhere to all company safety policies
  • Attend training to improve HVAC industry knowledge
  • Perform preventative maintenance; identify potential issues (e.g., contactors, relay coils, over-amping devices, loads, transformers, motors)
  • Perform electrical troubleshooting; able to read various wiring diagrams (ladder, schematic, parallel, series circuits)
  • Understand all phases of line voltage (single phase, three phase, part start windings, two-speed motors, variable frequency drives)
  • Understand general fan laws: RPM, speed, how pulley or sheave changes and belt sizing affect amperage draw
  • Calculate CFM using heat rise or static pressure method
  • Understand piping systems: refrigerant, water, gas, condensate, pumps, valves (single/two-pipe systems, bypass circuits, modulating valves, circuit setters)
  • Understand water source equipment: water-cooled condensers, chillers, cooling towers, fluid coolers, basic water treatment knowledge
  • Calculate wire sizes, fuses, and circuit breakers for both low and line voltage loads
  • Install and program common DDC controls (e.g., Carrier, Trane)
  • Understand operation differences between VAV and VVT boxes
  • Identify and work with all types of thermostats: low/line voltage, standard, programmable, digital, and time clocks
  • Perform leak detection for water and refrigerant systems
  • Possess knowledge of semi-hermetic compressors (change unloaders, valves, valve plates, internal bypass plugs; diagnose mechanical and electrical failures)
  • Understand relationships between temperature, pressure, humidity, and their effects on indoor air comfort and quality
  • Understand the purpose and process of test and balance for building performance, pressure control, and comfort
  • Diagnose and repair all types of heating and cooling issues as required
  • Possess all necessary tools to complete tasks listed in the job description

Qualification:

  • Physical activities include standing, balancing, climbing stairs and ladders
  • Must be able to walk and lift 20 pounds or more as part of daily job duties
  • Requires use of upper extremities for forward and overhead reaching, pushing, pulling, and material handling
  • Requires use of torso and lower extremities for kneeling, crawling, stooping, twisting, and squatting

jobs.title: Maintenance Worker I / Facilities
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work. The class is responsible for the maintenance of City property using hand or power tools or equipment. Workers typically perform a variety of tasks, which may, include any combination of the following: light carpentry, digging, raking, sprinkler installation and repair, painting and power washing and completing logs or routine records. The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates vehicles such as trucks to haul people or material to job sites.
  • Loads and unloads materials such as gravel, dirt, timber, chemicals, or other materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Performs utility service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches, assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes and irrigation systems.
  • Performs maintenance functions such as repairing irrigation, greasing pumps, motors, and shafts, and replacing valves; performs light repairs and installations as directed.
  • Maintains indoor areas such as cleaning facilities and indoor areas, performing light maintenance such as painting and minor repairs.
  • Assists the public by answering questions and providing routine information.
  • Performs clerical tasks such as completing work orders or maintaining logs.
  • Compares or inspects items against a standard.
  • Follows instructions and orders of supervisor.
  • Makes a few decisions, affecting only the individual.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires two years or more of routine manual work experience.

  • Must possess a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment at time of hire.

jobs.title: Plant Tech Apprentice
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain wastewater plant facilities, fixtures, and equipment.  The class is responsible for scheduling or performing preventive maintenance, installations, repairs, and reports.  The class works within a general outline of work to be performed; develops work methods and sequences under general supervision. Requires the ability to work independently, exercising judgment and initiative.

Essential Job Functions

  • Schedules and performs preventive maintenance on plant fixtures, systems, and equipment in accordance with prescribed schedules.
  • Troubleshoots malfunctions and repairs; reports major malfunctions to supervisor for further action.
  • Performs troubleshooting and repair of single phase, three phase, low voltage control systems, process control equipment and Scada systems.
  • Removes and replaces equipment or components; installs new equipment or components.
  • Performs operator tasks as assigned including taking readings, adjusting parameters, and other operations tasks.
  • Maintains plant facility and grounds including building maintenance, mowing grass, cleaning area of trash and debris, and other maintenance.
  • Maintain satellite facilities such as plant facilities.
  • Maintains logs of maintenance actions and prepares periodic or special reports.
  • Monitors condition of vehicles assigned; performs minor maintenance and service; reports major malfunctions to supervisor.
  • Attends staff meetings to exchange information; attends in-service training and technical classes to improve technical skills.
  • Performs routine office tasks, such as typing, filing, faxing, phoning, and copying.
  • Call back status is required during emergency conditions. 
  • Inspects, sets-up, and otherwise prepares new equipment to be placed in service.
  • This position is subject to assigned on call rotation.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. 

  • Prefer a minimum of one year in the areas of electrical and mechanical abilities, with the ability to troubleshoot and repair water and wastewater treatment and processing equipment.

  • Prefer knowledge in Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), relay logic, pumps, motors, gearboxes and all other equipment as it relates to water and wastewater processing.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 

  • Must obtain a Class A CDL with air brake endorsement within 18 months of employment.  
  • Must obtain a Utility Maintenance III Certification within 18 months of employment.   
  • Confined Space Entry Certification within 18 months of hire (City can provide training but preferred at time of hire)

jobs.title: Accountant II
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

This is a newly established position included in the FY 26–27 adopted budget, effective October 1, 2026.

The purpose of the class is to provide responsible accounting functions in conformance with generally accepted accounting principles. The class is responsible for accounting, disbursement, maintenance, review, interpretation, analysis and reconciliation of accounts within assigned area of responsibility. The class works within a general outline of work to be performed, and develops work methods and sequences under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Performs accounting functions in accordance with Federal, State, and local laws, rules, and requirements for assigned accounts.
  • Reconciles all funds and accounts for assigned areas of responsibility; researches discrepancies, collects information, and reports findings.
  • Posts payments, journal and ledger entries as assigned.
  • Monitors financial and management systems such as cash receipts, utility billing, asset utilization and work order control systems for efficiency and accuracy; may conduct physical inventories of assets.
  • Prepares required financial reports such as grants, statistical information, capital projects drawdown schedules and other.
  • Assists with budget preparation which includes revenue projections and capital projects.
  • Prepares audit documents, performs periodic or special audits.
  • Assists with preparation of the City Annual Financial Report. (CAFR).
  • Performs data entry of all financial activities for assigned accounts and funds; verifies and reconciles accuracy of data entered.
  • Attends staff or project meetings to exchange information; attends in-service training and technical or professional classes, seminars, or conferences to improve technical or professional skills.
  • Performs routine office tasks, such as typing, filing, faxing, phoning, and copying.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires an associate’s degree with emphasis in accounting. A comparable amount of training, education and experience may be substituted for associate’s degree requirement. Requires two years or more of work experience in accounting.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred. A bachelor’s degree may be substituted for work experience requirement.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

The levels below require a high school diploma, GED, and formal training, special courses, or self-educated equivalent to satisfying completion of one year of college educated or specialized advanced training in the Wastewater field.  Must live within a 20-mile radius of the city limits of Leesburg within six (6) months of employment due to on-call rotation requirement. May mentor and assist in training of less experienced operations staff.  Maintain compliance using experience and best management practices. Must possess a valid Florida driver’s license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 

Performs semi-skilled work involving set procedures but solves frequent problems. Uses basic algebra involving variables and formulas, basic geometry involving plane and solid figures, such as circumferences, areas, and volumes, and computes ratios, rates, percent's, or other parameters. Reads routine sentences, instructions, regulations, procedures, or work orders; writes routine sentences and completes routine job forms and incident reports, speaks routine sentences using proper grammar. Performs clerical, manual, and technical tasks prescribed by standard practices but which may require computation, the use of several procedures, and the use of independent judgment with obvious choices; requires normal attention for accurate results.
   
Wastewater Operator C
 
Requires 2080 hours of experience in wastewater treatment. Must possess a valid FDEP “C” license in Wastewater Plant Operations. Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

Wastewater Operator B
 
Requires 6240 hours of experience in wastewater treatment. Must possess a valid FDEP “B” license in Wastewater. Special skills or equipment certification may be required.
 
Wastewater Operator A
 
Requires 10,400 hours of experience in wastewater treatment. Must possess a valid FDEP “A” license in Wastewater. Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Library Reference Assistant
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to provide paraprofessional, customer-oriented library services. The class is responsible for performing advanced bibliographic searches in intra-library loan, acquisition, or circulation functions and/or information services using all available library sources and tools; providing research and/or assistance in public service areas involving extensive public contact in advising patrons in the use and location of physical materials, online and digital resources, public computers, and mobile devices. 

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates library computers for data entry and information retrieval.
  • Assists with planning and preparation of flyers, posters, and bibliographies for the library.
  • Participates in special civic and library events.
  • Staffs service points to assist patrons in circulation, information, and reference activities, including Readers’ Advisory.
  • Performs trouble-shooting tasks on computers, and assists patrons with public computer and equipment use.
  • Assists the librarians with technology classes and programs.
  • Helps maintain and add content on the Library’s social media accounts.
  • Performs tasks related to digitizing and preserving material in the library’s special collections. 
  • Assists patrons and staff with current technologies and applications, such as mobile devices, social media, etc.
  • Plans and coordinates the scheduling and borrowing of Book Club materials.
  • Conducts bibliographic searches for serials, periodicals, special collections, and print and non-print materials.
  • Assists librarians with aspects of collection development including selection, recommendations, and weeding.
  • Attends staff meetings to exchange information, attends in-service training and technical classes, webinars, or conferences to improve technical skills.
  • Performs related tasks such as managing desk, phone, and email inquiries, directing vendors and service technicians to the appropriate persons, and assisting with various library projects.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a bachelor’s degree or associate degree with public library experience.

  • Requires experience with public library organizations and customer service experience or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience, which provides the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities for this job. Requires strong computer skills, experience with Microsoft Office applications and mobile devices.

  • Must be able to work evenings and some Saturdays.  

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. Must be able to work weekends and evenings.

jobs.title: Trades Technician
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City buildings, facilities, grounds, and irrigation systems. The class is responsible for installation, modification, maintenance, and repair of facilities including electrical, carpentry, mechanical, plumbing, painting, masonry, outdoors structures and fixtures, and completing logs, forms, and reports. Also responsible for the efficient maintenance of City parks. The class works according to some procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects or monitors condition of buildings, structures, fixtures, equipment, and outside structures for needed maintenance or repairs
  • Initiates installation, modification, construction, maintenance or repair actions in response to inspections or work orders in regards to plumbing, HVAC, and electrical. 
  • Estimates materials and determines tools, support equipment, or other things needed for job; secures needed items and transports to job site.
  • Performs indoor maintenance including painting, carpentry, plumbing, electrical or mechanical repairs, fixture moving or repair, and other.
  • Performs outdoor maintenance including concrete work, painting, roof replacing or repairs, structure or fixture repair, and other.
  • Assists other departments or offices with maintenance tasks.
  • Maintains job-related forms such as logs, activity reports, material reports, and other.
  • Operate a wide variety of Maintenance equipment. 
  • Work in adverse weather conditions.
  • Work independently or with other staff.
  • Effectively communicate and deal with public.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. Requires a minimum of four years of job-related experience.

  • Must have a good working knowledge of plumbing – repairs and maintenance, HVAC preventative maintenance, and electrical troubleshooting/minor repairs.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Civilian Criminal Investigator
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

This is part-time (no more than 25 hours per week) technical work assignment in the investigation of fraud and property crime offenses. The class works according to procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Investigate Felony Property Crimes, to include fraud and grand theft. Collect and preserve information and evidence.  Coordinate with Sworn Detectives to conduct searches and make appropriate referrals of cases to outside agencies.
  • Participate in gathering intelligence information. Check sources of information.
  • Take statements. Attend and testify in court.
  • Coordinate with Sworn Detectives to obtain and execute warrants.
  • Identify and recover stolen property.
  • Prepare written reports of complaints and investigations.
  • The investigator may be assigned or assist in property room management.
  • The investigator may log in property or review evidence.
  • Maintain follow-up investigative reports and assist victims of Felony Property Crimes.
  • Work in conjunction with the State Attorney’s Office and other outside agencies as needed.

Minimum Requirements

Must possess a High School Diploma or General Education Diploma (GED) equivalency; supplemented by course work in modern police work and investigative techniques. At least five (5) years of experience as a Police Detective/Investigator. Knowledge of laws and ordinances governing local police work, business English and spelling, report writing skills, State Statutes, office practice and procedures, and codes used in radio communications. Skilled in investigative techniques, use of certain police equipment, operation of motor vehicles. Applicant must have the ability to work with high degree of independence, understand and execute difficult oral and written directions, access, and input and retrieve information from a computer, learn assigned investigative tasks readily and to adhere to prescribed routines. Applicant must also have the skill set to meet and deal courteously with the general public; interview victims, witnesses, and suspects in a professional manner; deal courteously with unruly, concerned parties of all cases; effectively and harmoniously communicate with other employees; prepare clear and comprehensive reports; react quickly and calmly in emergencies. Applicant must be able to execute duties firmly, tactfully and impartially; and have the ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.

jobs.title: Police Officer
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to protect life and property, enforce laws, and investigate crime. The class is responsible for surveillance, law enforcement, investigations, apprehension, and reporting. The class works according to procedures; decides how and when to do things under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Conducts routine patrols in residential and business areas; maintains contact with businesses and residents to establish good relations.
  • Responds to calls for police service and responds to crimes, domestic disputes, disturbances, disputes among neighbors, juveniles, or other incidents; apprehends law breakers as necessary; conducts follow-up investigations of crimes and other incidents, conducts surveillance of areas for suspected or potential criminal activity
  • Provides information and/or assistance to the public, informing citizens of services in the community, or providing referrals to other city, county, or state agencies.
  • Maintains the peace and safety of the community by quelling public disturbances and maintaining order at group functions.
  • Provides for the safe and convenient flow of traffic and pedestrians within the community, investigates traffic accidents, enforces traffic violations, promotes vehicular and pedestrian safety, reports unsafe road conditions, and conducts DUI or other investigations.
  • Issues civil or legal documents such as traffic citations; prepares written reports, forms, and other documents as required; may testifies in civil and criminal court proceedings or give depositions.
  • Provides specialized police service when trained and assigned such as K-9, Bicycle Patrol, Motorcycle Patrol, or other.  
  • May perform administrative or specialized functions when trained and assigned such as administrative support services, property and evidence, field and firearms training, public information, athletics, or other. 

Minimum Requirements

Requires a high school diploma or GED. Applicants currently serving in the military or currently employed as a certified law enforcement officer, seeking to relocate to this area and hold a valid driver's license, will be eligible to test and interview. Police Recruit opportunity also available to anyone interested in becoming a Police Officer with our agency. Prior or current attendance at a Law Enforcement academy is not required to be eligible to test and interview. However, if offered a recruit opportunity, the applicant will be required to enroll in a State of Florida approved Criminal Justice Training Center for Law Enforcement Certification Training or Comparative Compliance Course prior to commencing employment. All applicants must pass the State Exam prior to becoming a Police Officer. Reserve Police Officer opportunities may also be available, as needed, and applicants must meet the minimum requirements noted within this description.

An eligibility list will be established for future openings.  

Employee must live within a 20-mile radius of the Leesburg city limits within 15 months of employment. 

Marginal Job Functions

This position gathers, organizes, analyzes, examines, or evaluates data or information and may prescribe action based on such data or information.  Persuades or influences others in favor of a service, point of view, or course of action; may enforce laws, rules, regulations, or ordinances.  Handles or uses machines, tools, or equipment that requires moderate instruction and experience such as protective equipment, police vehicles, firearms, computers, and software programs such as word processing, spreadsheets or custom law enforcement applications.  Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.   Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percent. Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form. Performs technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.  Guides others, making frequent decisions, affecting the individual, coworkers, and others that depend on the service or product.

jobs.title: Water Distribution Tech Apprentice
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

This is an entry-level class in the Water Distribution Division. This class works under supervision on a training basis in the performance of a wide variety of routine unskilled to semi-skilled water maintenance tasks that do not require previous water experience. General work is observed and reviewed during performance and upon completion, and changes in procedures or exceptions to rules, are explained in detail as they arise. The class is responsible for maintaining logs and records, and general system maintenance.  The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.  Employees at this level are not expected to perform with the same independence of direction and judgment on matters related to established procedures and guidelines as are positions allocated to the III level. Since this class is typically used as a training class, employees may have only limited or non-directly related work experience. Employees work under immediate supervision while learning job tasks. Weekend, holiday and after hours work may be required, as well as after-hours response and emergencies.

Essential Job Functions

  • Responds to complaints from public; resolves issues or refers to supervisor for resolution.
  • Maintains logs and records as required.
  • Performs routine office tasks, such as typing, filing, faxing, phoning, copying, and maintaining logs and records.
  • Make minor adjustments on service equipment; maintain tools and equipment in working order.
  • Lay and fit pipelines; make water line taps; install water services, fire hydrants, valves, and other water devices.
  • Excavate trenches and install shoring

  • Perform related duties as required.

Minimum Requirements

jobs.title: Maintenance Worker I - Grounds
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to perform routine manual work.  This class is responsible for service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, valves, fittings, and manholes; landscape, road, sidewalk, driveway restoration and other outdoor work.  Completes logs or routine records.  The class works according to set procedures under direct supervision.   

Essential Job Functions

  • Operates vehicles such as trucks to transport people or material to job sites.
  • Loads and unloads materials such as gravel, dirt, timber, chemicals, or other materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Maintains outdoor areas by cutting grass, pruning trees and bushes, raking leaves and debris, installing landscape material, and other maintenance tasks.
  • Performs utility service work such as digging trenches, cleaning ditches; assists with installation of fixtures such as pipes, manholes, and sewer lines.
  • Performs maintenance functions such as repairing irrigation, greasing pumps, motors, and shafts, and replacing valves; performs light repairs and installations as directed.
  • Maintains indoor areas such as cleaning facilities and indoor areas, performing light maintenance such as painting and minor repairs.
  • Assists the public by answering questions and providing routine information.
  • Performs clerical tasks such as completing work orders or maintaining logs.
  • Compares or inspects items against a standard.
  • Follows oral and written directions; communication effectively in both oral and written form of supervisor
  • Makes a few decisions, affecting only the individual.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work, including City and other government officials, community groups, and the general public; and applying safe work practices.

Minimum Requirements

Previous experience working in a ground’s maintenance position preferred, but not required. Employee will receive on the job training.


General knowledge of computer usage preferred.


Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. 


May be required to acquire and maintain a specific applicators license.

Marginal Job Functions

  • Attends unit meetings, in-service training, workshops, etc. for the purpose of gathering information required to perform job functions.  
  • Performs other related duties as assigned for ensuring the efficient and effective functioning of the work unit.

jobs.title: Fleet Manager
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

Performs administrative and managerial work directing the City’s centralized fleet division. Work involves responsibility for planning and directing the fleet management program, contractors and city employees; to include the maintenance, servicing, modification and repair of municipal vehicles. Responsible also for replacement and disposal of a wide variety of automotive, vehicular, emergency and heavy construction equipment. Develops and submits bid specifications for vehicle and equipment purchases.  The class works within broad policy and organizational guidelines; independently plans and implements projects; reports progress of major activities through periodic conferences and meetings.

Essential Job Functions

  • Supervises staff including selecting or recommending selection, training, assigning and evaluating work, counseling, discipline, and recommending termination.
  • Coordinates operations with all City departments and the public; analyzes preventive maintenance and repair procedures, establishes and organizes repair priorities; evaluates replacement and expanding equipment needs for the City; declares equipment excess to City needs.
  • Develops policies and procedures for safety and daily operations in accordance with requirements and guidelines, promulgates, and evaluates to ensure compliance.
  • Operates and maintains vehicle and equipment fueling and cleaning stations.
  • Inspects or diagnoses vehicles or equipment with complex problems; advises and assists subordinates, or performs especially difficult or complex maintenance tasks.
  • Prepares and administers annual budget; establishes and or reviews and approves program goals and objectives; monitors and ensures adherence to include maintenance and repair cost on vehicles.
  • Attends or conducts staff meetings to exchange information; attends, and schedules others to attend, in-service training and technical classes, seminars, or conferences to improve skills.  
  • Develop and implement specific computer systems and software relative to operations of the Fleet Division of Public Works. Review of periodic analytical reports on performance; ensure attainment of desired goals and level of Service.
  • Formulates operating policies and procedures and establishes work standards and performance metrics; develops fiscal year work calendar relative to the maintenance management program.

Minimum Requirements

  • Degree in Automotive Engineering, Automotive Technology, Business Management or related discipline preferred. Eight or more years of experience in an automotive fleet environment with a minimum of four (4) years as a supervisor or manager in a fleet environment. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Performs supervisory work involving policy and guidelines, solving both people and work related problems.

  • Uses basic algebra involving variables and formulas, basic geometry involving plane and solid figures such as circumferences, areas, or volumes; may compute ratios, rates, or percents.

  • Read technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports, forms, and letters; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs specialized technical and administrative work requiring general understanding of operating policies and procedures and their application to problems not previously encountered; applies specialized technical or professional principles and practices in the solution of problems; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results and occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida Class B CDL and satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment.  
     
    Must obtain a valid State of Florida Class “A” Commercial Driver’s License within six (6) months of hire date. 

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Senior ER Technician
jobs.description_html:
Nature of Work

The purpose of the class is to maintain City motorized vehicles and equipment.  The class is responsible for preventive maintenance, major and minor repairs, vehicle modifications, maintenance documentation, and parts inventories.   The class works within a general outline of work to be performed, develops work methods and sequences under general supervision.

Essential Job Functions

  • Inspects vehicles and equipment and performs preventive maintenance.
  • Performs highly specialized diagnostic and repair to fire pumps, governor systems, control valves and plumbing on fire apparatus to include aerial and ARRF.
  • Installs and repairs emergency vehicle equipment for police and fire vehicles.
  • Inspects, sets-up, and otherwise prepares new vehicles and equipment to be placed in service.
  • Performs routine minor maintenance such as tire change, timing, adjusting, and lubricating.
  • Performs major repairs such as engine overhaul or transmission repair or replacement.
  • May perform vehicle modification such as installing or removing special equipment, or other modifications.
  • May perform State safety inspections as required.
  • Must have knowledge of NFPA standards.
  • May train or advise less experienced personnel.
  • Performs shop or area maintenance such as general clean up.
  • Prepares documentation for maintenance activities such as repairs, parts used, cost, and other information.
  • Provides advice and assistance to vehicle or equipment operators as necessary.

Minimum Requirements

  • Requires a high school diploma or GED. 

  • Requires a minimum of five (5) years of experience in fire apparatus, police vehicles, automobiles, heavy equipment maintenance and repairs. Must have experience with diagnostics scanning tools or a closely related field.

  • Performs skilled work involving rules/systems but solves problems almost constantly.

  • Performs addition and subtraction, multiplication and division and/or calculates ratios, rates and percents.

  • Reads technical instructions, procedures manuals, and charts to solve practical problems; composes routine and specialized reports and forms; speaks compound sentences using normal grammar and word form.

  • Performs manual and technical tasks requiring a wide range of procedures and requiring intensive understanding of a restricted field or complete familiarity with the functions of a unit or small division of an operating agency; requires normal attention with short periods of concentration for accurate results or occasional exposure to unusual pressure.

  • Requires a valid State of Florida driver license and a satisfactory driving record as a condition of initial and continued employment. Must have a State of Florida Class A CDL within six (6) months of employment.   

  • Must have and maintain a minimum of five (5) EVT certifications in fire apparatus within eighteen (18) months of employment.  

  • Special skills or equipment certification may be required.

jobs.title: Customer Service/Data Entry
jobs.description_html:
Job description:

Large Distribution Center in Sanford is looking for a skilled & dependable candidate that can absorb quickly in a fast-paced environment, and multitask w/ minimal supervision. A team player, self starter, self motivator that will take initiative to troubleshoot and correct issues if needed.

Work Hours: M-F, 8:00am – 4:30pm

Pay Rate: $19- $20/hr.

Duties and Requirements:

  • Office/clerical/ warehouse tasks.
  • Shipping and receiving experience is a huge plus!
  • Data Entry.
  • Ability to use a computer, MS Office Software, email and operation software.
  • Familiar with SAP Business ONE, QuickBooks, sage, or any related distribution system, including but not limited to FedEx or UPS.
  • Create SAP notifications based on information received from employees (electronically or in-person), including: (i) a description of the problem; (ii) all equipment affected; (iii) the submitter’s name; and (iv) a priority ranking.

  • Drop orders as they come in
  • Answer incoming phone calls

  • Attention to detail
  • Reliable transportation.
  • dependable (show up to work consistently).
  • Can work with minimal supervision and can handle fast paced environment.

Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Houseman/Housekeeping
jobs.description_html:
Job description:

Housekeeper / Houseman
Location: Venus, FL
Pay Rate: $18 per hour

We’re looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Housekeeper/Houseman to support daily operations at a luxury property. This role plays an important part in creating a clean, organized, and welcoming environment for guests. A strong eye for detail, pride in your work, and a genuine commitment to hospitality are key to being successful in this position.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and set up designated areas, ensuring all spaces are clean, organized, and guest-ready.
  • Clean and maintain offices, breakrooms, hallways, restrooms, and select outdoor areas.
  • Dust, mop, vacuum, and disinfect surfaces; restock supplies in restrooms and common areas.
  • Conduct routine inspections of assigned spaces and address cleanliness or maintenance needs promptly.
  • Work with management and maintenance teams on special requests and general inquiries.
  • Report safety concerns or maintenance issues to the appropriate team members.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays when needed.

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in housekeeping, hospitality, private clubs, or luxury resort settings is preferred.
  • Familiarity with cleaning tools, equipment, and supplies is helpful.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well within a team.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods and safely lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in a range of temperatures, including high heat and cold conditions.
  • Comfortable reading, writing, and speaking English.
  • Clean background

Background check and drug screen is required.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.description_html:
Role Overview:

The Warehouse Associate is responsible for maintaining all stock inventory and pulling orders for manufacturing according to designated work orders by performing the following duties. These duties may vary to include some or all of the following job responsibilities.


Duties/Responsibilities:

· Determines work assignments and material or equipment needs based on written work orders or oral instructions.

· Responsible for order-fulfillment including packaging and banding orders, labeling product, and stacking finished orders on skids.

· May be required to maintain all stock inventories for warehouse daily.

· Maneuvers heavy materials with the use of forklift, pallet and hand truck as required.

· Responsible for unskilled production work on assembly line.

· Loads and Unloads shipping trucks as required.

· Maintains and ensures all machines and equipment are functioning according to established work standards and follows all safety guidelines and regulations.

· Assists shipping area with package procedures, including label printing, as requested.

· Monitors products for quality and uniformity; reports any identified problems to Supervisor/Manager in timely manner.

· May be asked to stand in as a backup for Line Leads as needed.

· Complies with company policies and procedures giving special attention to safety regulations.

· Promotes self-improvement in assigned tasks and always maintains a clean and safe work environment by sweeping, cleaning, and removing trash.

· Performs other related duties as assigned.


Required Skills/Abilities:

· Ability to follow directions and work well in a team.

· Ability to handle materials and equipment in a responsible manner.

· Ability to work in a variety of roles

· Basic understanding of or ability to quickly learn company products and terminology.

· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent customer service and time management skills.

· Ability to perform repetitive tasks.


Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

· Must be able to continuously lift and move up to 75 pounds.

· Must be able to perform physical activities that require considerable use of arms and legs and moving the entire body. This will include climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, carrying, bending, twisting, and stooping.

· Regularly exposed to fumes, allergens, or airborne particles, and outdoor weather conditions.

· May occasionally be exposed to mild chemicals.

· Occasionally exposed to electric powered equipment, conveyor belt and compressed air.

· The noise level in the work environment is moderate to high.

Box Truck Driver

Job description

Overview
We are seeking a reliable and dedicated Truck Driver to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for transporting goods safely and efficiently to various locations while ensuring excellent customer service. This role requires a strong commitment to safety, adherence to traffic regulations, and the ability to handle heavy lifting and moving tasks.

Duties

  • Operate box trucks, vans, or other delivery vehicles to transport goods to designated locations.
  • Load and unload cargo using pallet jacks and other equipment as necessary.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description_html:
As a Quality Engineer, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of NJM’s business applications. We are looking for an innovative Software Quality Engineer who can leverage Generative AI technologies to enhance testing effectiveness, efficiency, and coverage while maintaining human oversight and accountability.


In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated test suites across different applications, working closely with Developers, Functional Analysts, Product Owners, and Project Managers to ensure reliable, high-quality releases.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Work in an agile, small team environment with a focus on speed and quality
  • Review business and technical requirements to develop comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases
  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable test automation scripts to enable faster regression/delivery cycles
  • Perform manual and automated testing to ensure alignment with software requirements, risk assessments, and quality standards
  • Perform backend validation, webservices, and API testing using appropriate tools
  • Utilize Generative AI tools to optimize test coverage, prioritize regression testing, enhance defect detection, and accelerate root-cause analysis
  • Leverage AI-powered coding assistants to design, develop, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts, frameworks, and supporting utilities
  • Apply AI-assisted analysis to improve test coverage, regression scope and accelerate defect root-cause analysis.
  • Maintain and improve quality engineering, functional, technical and professional skills through continuous learning based on latest tools and technologies.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in software delivery, including 2+ years in Quality Engineering, QA, software testing, or test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
  • Experience in software engineering with hand-on coding proficiency in any language such as Java, Python, C# or JavaScript.
  • Practical experience using Generative AI tools to support testing activities
  • Demonstrated automation-first mindset with experience in working with scalable automated testing solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Expertise in SQL, API testing, and backend/system validation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in P&C Insurance Domain
  • Experience using Agentic AI–based testing tools to support automated test script generation, execution, and maintenance
  • Experience with test automation tools like Selenium and Playwright

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $83,741-$97,178

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer, Senior
jobs.description_html:
As a Senior Quality Engineer, you'll be responsible for functional and automation testing of NJM’s business applications. This role is expected to actively leverage Generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to enhance test design, automation development, defect analysis, test data generation, and overall software quality delivery.


The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to effectively combine quality engineering expertise with AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Work in an agile, small team environment with a focus on speed and quality
  • Contribute to test planning efforts and development of comprehensive test strategies by applying right testing techniques.
  • Design, develop, and maintain complex, reusable test automation scripts to enable faster regression/delivery cycles.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on quality objectives, requirements and contribute to delivering business value Incrementally.
  • Perform manual and automated testing to ensure alignment with software requirements, risk assessments, and quality standards
  • Perform backend validation, webservices, and API testing using appropriate tools
  • Identify system dependencies, test environments, integrations, tools and utilities needed for testing based on release/sprint goals.
  • Review Automation test coverage and plan to increase/maintain coverage as enhancements are being implemented in each release.
  • Use AI tools to automate repetitive quality engineering tasks, including test documentation, test maintenance, defect categorization, regression impact analysis, and release readiness assessments.
  • Develop and refine effective prompts and workflows that maximize the quality, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated testing artifacts and automation assets.
  • Integrate AI-enabled capabilities into Quality Engineering processes to improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and increase software delivery velocity.
  • Leverage AI-powered coding assistants to design, develop, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts, frameworks, and supporting utilities
  • Use AI-powered tools to assist in generating and maintaining API tests, UI automation tests, service virtualization assets, and regression test suites.

Required Qualifications:


  • 7+ years of experience in software delivery, including 5+ years in Quality Engineering, QA, software testing, or test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
  • Experience in software engineering with hand-on coding proficiency in any language such as Java, Python, C# or JavaScript.
  • Proven experience in building and driving an automation-first testing strategy, with ability to implement automated solutions across the software delivery life cycle.
  • Demonstrated experience utilizing Generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software testing and quality engineering outcomes
  • Strong experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, API testing, and backend/system validation.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to accelerate test design, test automation development, test data creation, and defect analysis
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in P&C Insurance Domain
  • Experience with Guidewire Insurance Suite
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted test automation solutions and intelligent test generation techniques

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $100,402-$116,574

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Underwriting Technician - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.


For the benefit of NJM’s Commercial Lines policyholders, the underwriting technician is responsible for policy transactions such as but not limited to new and renewal policy rating, issuance, and mid-term changes.  To also supplement the Commercial Customer Contact Center by handling customer inquiries. Work must be completed within the department’s established guidelines for time and quality of work.


The schedule for this position is 3 days in our West Trenton office and 2 days at home once in person training is complete. There is no fully remote option.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.


Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Verify accuracy and completeness of information necessary to process transactions
  • Process transactions such as mid-term changes and issue new business and renewal policies
  • Act on any specific renewal activities or instructions
  • Review incoming policy specification inquiries and/or Renewal Questionnaires and recognize changes that need to be addressed and/or referred
  • Manage all work assignments and plan for date sensitive activities in advance of taking PTO
  • When unsure of how to handle a particular situation, seek advice and guidance from supervisor or other senior staff
  • May handle certificate requests from customers in a timely fashion. If the certificates require more attention, they are to be sent to Supervisor or other senior staff for advice and guidance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma
  • Ability to work with a high degree of accuracy and strong attention to detail
  • Strong communications skills (verbal, written and active listening)
  • Ability to multi-task and to deal with interruptions and able to regain focus on task at hand
  • Proficiency in computer usage, accurate data entry, Microsoft office suite and business-related software
  • Ability to collaborate with co-workers

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.


NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $46,950-$54,546

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Actuarial Intern
jobs.description_html:
Consider joining NJM’s 2027 Paid Summer Intern Program!


This robust program includes:

  • Lunch with leaders; featuring insights from an Executive Leadership Team member, and a former NJM intern. Opportunity to network with leaders and professionals across multiple departments.
  • Contribute to and collaborate on meaningful work within your department.
  • Team Intern Project: Research and present a business question to NJM leaders.
  • NJM Seminars designed to build essential professional skills and expand knowledge of the insurance industry.
  • Professional headshots to help enhance your personal brand.
  • Intern Fun:
    • Night at the Trenton Thunder Game
    • Volunteer activities to give back to the community in which we serve
    • Networking and social events with fellow interns, former interns, and leaders

Overview

NJM Insurance Group is looking for several dynamic, energetic interns who are eager to learn about our company by assisting various projects in the Actuarial department. As an Actuarial Intern, you will be assigned to one of the main teams in the department: Personal Auto Pricing, Property Pricing, Commercial Lines pricing, or Reserving.

Project assignments vary year to year but there are several common themes:

  • Teaches basic knowledge of Actuarial techniques and provides meaningful applications of coding languages
  • Involves data gathering/transformation and learning to extract insights out of data
  • Provides a chance to work closely with other actuaries on a day-to-day basis and gain experience in a professional setting
  • Offers an opportunity to communicate results to management

To be successful as an Intern, you should be willing to help with any tasks assigned by a supervisor. You will be involved in upcoming and current projects.

Examples of Prior Intern Projects

  • Creating a tool that automated the analysis of quotes and bind information
  • Completing a Countrywide reserve review for an entire Line of Business
  • Developing an automation tool that iteratively analyze 100’s of rating variables
  • Performing in-depth analysis of a pricing variable by utilizing a simulation tool to test rates against competitors
  • Conducting a thorough competitor insights analysis for the launch of a new Line of Business
  • Performing cluster analysis to define customer classes
  • Completing full profitability and impact analysis of a potential new product
  • Analyzing industry loss trends and developing proposals

Responsibilities

  • Learn about the insurance industry and basic Actuarial techniques (such as extension of exposure on-leveling, loss development triangles, etc.) and applying them to solve real business problems
  • Learn and heavily utilize Excel, SQL, SAS, and/or PowerBi in various projects
  • Lead a pricing or reserving project, develop recommendations based on the analysis, and present findings to management and/or other departments
  • Conduct research and provide ad-hoc assistance to on-going projects with other actuaries in the department

Requirements

  • Commutable to our West Trenton, New Jersey office
  • Current Sophomores and Juniors pursuing Math, Actuarial, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, or other quantitative field
  • Must have 3.0 GPA or higher, overall
  • Self-directed learner with the ability to learn quickly and pursue Internship with enthusiasm and focus Advance skills in MS Word, Outlook, and Excel
  • Ability to work well on a team or individually
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Willingness and ability to learn Property & Casualty Insurance

The Actuarial Intern can pay from $21- $25 hour.

Starting Rate: $21

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.
