jobs.title: Commercial Lines Pricing Actuary - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Actuary (this role can be filled at the level, I, II , Senior or Associate level) will support NJM’s efforts to attract new policyholders, retain existing policyholders, and honor our commitment to pay claims by developing fair and competitive pricing, providing comprehensive product analysis, and ensuring that NJM maintains a strong financial position.

This role is hybrid working 3 days in the West Trenton, NJ office and 2 days from home.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Perform pricing studies to evaluate the profitability of our Auto, Workers’ Compensation, and Commercial Package insurance products. 

  • Analyze rating variables based on company data and competitor information and recommend changes.

  • Perform analysis of frequency, severity, and premium trends.

  • Perform analysis of loss and LAE reserves.

  • Assist with the annual loss and LAE ratio planning process.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop business insights and recommendations. 

  • Contribute to the ongoing development of actuarial tools and processes to enhance the department’s capabilities over time.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, or related field.

  • Property and casualty actuarial experience. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SQL, SAS, or other programming languages a plus.  

  • ACAS or FCAS credential.

This role can be filled at the Analyst, Associate or Senior level and the salary is commensurate based on experience.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $116,749-$147,145

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Coding & Reimbursement Specialist
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company has an opening for a Coding & Reimbursement Specialist in its Medical Claim Services Department.  The location for this position will be based in West Trenton.  The department is seeking an individual that can be a team player while accurately and efficiently auditing medical bills by applying the correct medical, coding, and regulatory guidelines.

Hours:  Monday to Friday from 8AM to 4:15PM

Hybrid opportunity once training is complete

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Accurately and clearly apply regulatory, coding, and medical guidelines, as well as company policies and procedures to audited bills.

  • Bill negotiation.

  • Provide concise and clear instructions for bill processing.  For those procedures requiring audit reports, cite relevant resources, when appropriate.

  • Conduct ongoing review and/or audit of bills as needed for appeals, demands for arbitration, and suit.  Provide concise and clear audit reports, including rationale for denials and/or reductions, citing relevant resources and supplying supporting documentation, when necessary.

  • Keep abreast of industry trends and requirements that impact the auditing process.  Research new procedures and technology and provide feedback to team and management on implications.

  • Recommend value-add strategies for addressing new trends and services.

  • Report on tasks, audit volume, output, savings, etc., as needed and required by supervisor and/or management.

  • Complete continuing education credits needed to maintain certification(s).

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Knowledge of Excel, Word and Outlook

  • Strong communication and writing skills

  • Accuracy and attention to detail

  •  Knowledge of PIP, Workers Compensation, and/or Medicare coding regulations and guidelines

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Mitchell DecisionPoint and/or Guidewire Claim Center

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) designation

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $58,737-$74,031

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

The Commercial Lines Business Process Operations team is dedicated to enhancing operations efficiency and driving continuous improvement within our organization, They also strive to turn strategy into execution and delivery of valuable business solutions for the continued benefit of policyholders and employees in line with our Strategic Plan and in accordance with our corporate Mission, Vision, and Values.

Reporting to the Commercial Lines Compliance Administrator, the CL Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible and accountable for conducting complete and thorough reviews of Commercial Lines operational activities and transactions through execution of cyclical, repetitive quality assessments, utilizing established testing methodology.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Create and update Quality Assurance Manuals for each Commercial Lines Product.
  • Collaborate with CL members to discuss established processes by line of business.
  • Develop and execute audit programs to verify adherence to defined quality requirements.
  • Identify and document quality exceptions in an established structured reporting format.
  • Prepare quality assessment final dashboard reports and distribute to CL leaders.
  • Assist CL Compliance Administrator with presenting identified quality exceptions to CL leaders.
  • Participate in discussions with CL leaders regarding exception remediation plans.
  • Coordinate efforts with the CL Compliance Specialist to ensure proper testing coverage of all operational and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the CL department effort to ensure application access is appropriate to key applications that are used to support CL operations.
  • Execute rate change audit programs for all products and all states to ensure compliance to the established rate change implementation process.
  • Develop and execute targeted quality reviews assigned by the CL Compliance Administrator.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Desire to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • 3-5 years of Commercial Property and Casualty product underwriting experience preferred.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and problem solving ability.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.
  • Pro-active and self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly and adapt to change.
  • Team player with demonstrated ability to work in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Good working knowledge of MS Office, (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Policy Center, Billing Center Guidewire products, as well as OnBase document repository.
  • GED or High School Diploma required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: Senior Workday Integration Developer (Workday Studio, EIB, REST/SOAP, HCM & Finance)
jobs.description_html:
Seeking a highly skilled Workday Integration Developer (official NJM job title) to design, develop, enhance, and support integrations between Workday and enterprise applications across HCM and Finance.

This role is responsible for delivering scalable, secure, and reliable integration solutions using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, PECI, Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP), and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS). The ideal candidate possesses deep technical expertise within the Workday ecosystem, a strong understanding of Workday security and tenant management, and a proven track record of implementing enterprise-grade integrations in complex environments.

The successful candidate will partner closely with HCM, Finance, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions while ensuring integration performance, data integrity, compliance, and operational stability. This role also serves as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on integration architecture, development standards, testing strategies, and Workday best practices.

Job Responsibilities:

Integration Design & Development

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations utilizing:
    • Workday Studio
    • Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
    • Core Connectors
    • Cloud Connect
    • PECI/PICOF
    • Workday Web Services (REST and SOAP APIs)
  • Develop inbound and outbound integrations between Workday and external systems, including payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Create and maintain XSLT transformations, XML schemas, and integration mappings to support complex business requirements.
  • Design scalable integration architectures that follow Workday and enterprise integration best practices.
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration components and standards to improve supportability and efficiency.

Workday Configuration & Security

  • Configure and maintain Integration System Users (ISUs), Integration System Security Groups (ISSGs), domain security policies, and related security configurations.
  • Build and maintain custom reports, calculated fields, and Report-as-a-Service (RaaS) solutions supporting integration and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with functional teams to align business process configurations, approvals, and event triggers with integration requirements.

Production Support & Operational Excellence

  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues across production and non-production environments.
  • Develop robust error handling, auditing, alerting, and recovery processes to ensure reliable operations.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions to recurring issues.
  • Support Workday tenant refreshes, migrations, and release activities, including impact assessments and regression testing.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet organizational standards for security, compliance, performance, and data governance.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with HCM, Finance, IT, and external vendors to define requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.
  • Participate in technical design reviews and provide recommendations for improving integration of architecture and operational processes.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote Workday integration development best practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, including design specifications, support procedures, configuration details, and data flow diagrams.
  • Stay current with Workday releases, emerging technologies, and integration capabilities to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of Workday Integration development experience.
  • Advanced experience developing integrations using:
    • Workday Studio
    • EIB
    • Core Connectors
    • Workday Web Services (REST/SOAP)
       
  • Strong expertise with XSLT, XML, XPath, and integration design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of Workday HCM, Financial Management, and security architecture.
  • Experience configuring and supporting ISUs, ISSGs, and Workday security frameworks.
  • Experience building calculated fields, custom reports, and RaaS integrations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting Workday production environments and release management activities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Workday Pro Integrations Certification.
  • Experience with PECI, PICOF, Cloud Connect for Payroll, or other payroll-focused integrations.
  • Experience with Workday Extend and Workday Orchestrate.
  • Experience integrating Workday with payroll providers, benefits vendors, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and data privacy requirements related to HCM and Finance systems.

Key Competencies:

  • Workday Integration Architecture
  • Workday Studio Development
  • EIB and Core Connector Configuration
  • REST and SOAP API Development
  • XSLT/XML Transformation Design
  • Workday Security Administration
  • Report Writing and Calculated Fields
  • Troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Technical Documentation
  • Release and Tenant Management
  • Continuous Improvement and Best Practices

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $104,686-$121,638

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Workforce Supervisor, Stock Services
jobs.description_html:
The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the Stock Services department, including receiving, inventory control, stock distribution, courier functions, fleet-vehicle support, and mail transport activities.  This position provides direct supervision and guidance to the Stock Services Courier/Driver-Stock Clerk staff, insuring accurate inventory management, timely deliveries across the NJM campus, safe driving practices and high-level customer service.  The Stock Services Workforce Supervisor ensures compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and departmental standards while driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

SCHEDULE: Monday – Friday, 8:00 am to 4:15 pm

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Supervisor Responsibilities

  • Provide daily supervision, scheduling, and task assignments for Stock Services staff.
  • Oversee performance, provide coaching, conduct evaluations and support professional development.
  • Ensure team compliance with inventory procedures, safety protocols, and customer service standards.
  • Lead and participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new employees.
  • Monitor workload, prioritize department activities, and resolve operational issues promptly.
  • Maintain a positive, collaborative team environment and address performance or conduct issues as needed.

​Operational Oversight & Inventory Management

  • Supervise all receiving operations to ensure accurate inspection, counting, and documentation of deliveries.
  • Ensure that inventory items are properly transferred, stored, and tracked within the physical and system-based inventory locations.
  • Ensure stockroom inventory controls are in place and adhered to.
  • Communicate the delivery of stocked items with appropriate vendors to ensure adequate inventory levels.
  • Investigate vendor discrepancies, delivery issues, and product variances; communicate finding to appropriate departments.
  • Oversee timely fulfillment and delivery of stock orders to internal requestors while upholding customer service expectations.
  • Monitor and audit inventory management software (Workday) activity, including requisition approvals, receiving entries, serialized item logging, cycle counts, adjustments and required reporting.
  • Ensure safe and compliant operation of manual and electric pallet jacks and other equipment.
  • Support the development and maintenance of organized, efficient, and compliant stockroom areas.

Courier, Driver & Fleet Oversight

  • Oversee the daily courier/driver operations performed by staff, ensuring punctual and safe transport of cargo and/or passengers.
  • Ensure all vehicle loading, unloading, and delivery activities meet safety and company standards.

Departmental Support & Additional Duties

  • Develop and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.
  • Generate and review departmental activity reports, inventory reports, and metrics as required.
  • Serve as the operational point of contact for internal departments requiring Stock Services support.
  • Function as a backup to Stock Services staff completing their assigned tasks as needed.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 1-2 years of experience in a supervisory or leadership role.
  • 2-4 years of experience in inventory, warehouse, stock, or related operations.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and customer service skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to prioritize, adjust to changing demands, and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, perform repetitive movements, and stand or sit for long periods of time.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to maintain requirements for company fleet driving.
  • Ability to access all federal/government buildings.
  • Proficient with MS Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supervising stockroom, warehouse, inventory, or courier operations.
  • Prior inventory management system experience.
  • Knowledge of Workday Financials a plus.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $58,737-$74,031

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Hybrid
jobs.description_html:
New Jersey Manufacturers Insurance Company (NJM) was founded in 1913 by a group of manufacturers seeking to provide cost-effective, safety conscious and financially secure workers' compensation insurance for their workers. From inception the Company has operated as a mutual, with a focus on the needs of its policyholders.


Today, NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


Over the last five years, the Company has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

The purpose of the Project Management Team is to serve as a strong advocate and partner within NJM dedicated to driving the facilitation, planning and successful execution of approved business initiatives so that NJM can achieve its annual objectives, strategic goals and long-term vision. 

The Project Manager is responsible for managing one or more projects from startup through closeout and ensuring customer satisfaction. Project Managers need to be very comfortable around technology, be inquisitive, have a problem-solving mindset, and be willing to adapt approach to successfully execute projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Manage one or more independent projects from startup to closeout with some input from senior PMO members.
  • Demonstrate accountability with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers towards project implementations and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Demonstrate understanding and proficiency of Agile project management techniques and processes.  
  • Hold self and project team members accountable to deliverables and commitments.
  • Demonstrate awareness of project metrics and using metrics towards project discussions.
  • Work with Portfolio leadership to deal with dynamic situations and ambiguity.
  • Demonstrate the ability to adapt and perform in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
  • Collaborate with Technical Leads for Release and Sprint Planning, brainstorming, etc.
  • Demonstrate an analytical mindset and be comfortable working with data.
  • Take charge of situations, challenges, and leading the team towards resolution with guidance from senior project managers or portfolio managers.
  • Provide direction and day-to-day management of project teams.
  • Communicate transparently through status reporting and managing expectations of senior PMO leaders.
  • Understand project objectives and ensuring team member commitment towards achieving those objectives.
  • Engage in discussions with team members  to propose alternative solutions/approaches to address challenges.
  • Identifying challenges and risks (not just reporting status) and proactively seek resolution through support from PMO leadership.
  • Demonstrate awareness of various risk management strategies.
  • Prepare presentations regarding projects and their statuses to small audiences.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4-year degree or equivalent experience; technical or business background preferred.
  • Minimum 5-year work experience in a team setting; willingness to continue working in a team setting.
  • Basic understanding of tooling such as Jira, Planview, etc. Very proficient in MS Office (Excel, MS Word) and essential to be able to learn and utilize tooling.
  • Excellent and effective verbal and written communication skills (verbal, written, presentation) and facilitation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Scaled Agile or Scrum Master experience / certifications preferred Experience with Project budget management preferred.
  • Experience and understanding of P&C insurance a big plus.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

NJM reserves the right at any time to amend, add or delete any aspect of the job description for this position based on business needs.

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

jobs.title: Senior IVR & Contact Center Engineer (NICE CXone / Genesys)
jobs.description_html:
The Sr. Telecom Apps Software Engineer (official NJM job title) will have extensive knowledge of the NICE CX1 platform and is responsible for the design and development of voice/email/chat solutions on the NICE suite of applications used by contact center staff.  The person in this role will be the technical lead for IT and will be expected to translate software requirements into working solutions within the existing IVR application framework. The person serving this role will also be responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting systems for optimal performance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Customer support and troubleshooting
    • Perform analysis and resolve telecom related issues and service requests in a timely manner.
    • Assist immediate team members, extended IT team members and vendors to resolve complex and cross product issues.
    • Interact with vendor support and provide adequate communication about problem resolution.
    • Proactively monitor systems and take corrective action when required.
    • Document process and procedures according to established IT standards.
    • On a periodic frequency, insure that all supporting telecom systems are adequately patched with the appropriate application and security related updates.
    • Have a thorough understanding of NICE CX1 and related technologies.
       
  • Subject matter expert on IVR development
    • Design and develop IVR voice, chat and email solutions leveraging API’s to communicate to backend systems on the CX1 platform.
    • Act as the liaison for the business unit and IT.
    • Support the various IT system integrations to the telecom architecture.
    • Identify and correlate business requirements to software configurations solutions within the telecom applications.
    • Influence technical staff in the design and operation of telecom systems.
    • Serve as the point of contact for issue resolution and problem analysis.
    • Coordinate and run testing efforts to validate application functionality upon deployment of a fix and or platform upgrades.
       
  • Quality and documentation
    • Insure that team and individual deliverables are of high quality.
    • Service requests are resolved to end user satisfaction with minimal rework.
    • Effectively use available tools to diagnose and remedy user reported issues.
    • Create and document procedures adhering to established IT processes.
    • Maintain library of documentation to be used as a reference by immediate team members.
       
  • Continuous improvement
    • Maintain and improve technical proficiency through continuous learning of telecom products, supporting hardware and software environments.
    • Actively seeks to learn from senior team members as appropriate.
    • Serve as a mentor to junior team members.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of related information technology experience.
  • 5+ years of supporting telecom applications.
  • 5+ years of programming experience.
  • 3+ years of supporting Linux based application.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (computer science, engineering) or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of telecom system architecture to support a contact center environment on NICE CX1 platform.
  • Working knowledge of database design and operation, web technologies.
  • Proficiency and experience with certain operating systems (Windows, Linux)

Certifications or Licenses:

  • NICE Certified System Administrator (preferred but not required)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $91,021-$114,806

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Staff Attorney - Workers Compensation Claims
jobs.description_html:
The Workers Compensation Staff Attorney provides legal defense to policyholders and supports NJM’s Workers Compensation Claims Department.

jobs.title: JAVA Developer (Hybrid)
jobs.description_html:
This role will be responsible for developing, configuring and customizing business applications under the guidance of the team lead or a senior JAVA developer. The JAVA Developer will work in a highly collaborative environment as part on an agile delivery team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Code, configure, develop, and debug functionality in core systems in accordance with architectural guidelines and defined best practices under the guidance of a senior developer, this includes: screens, data model, batches.
  • Plan, initiate, and conduct unit and integration testing of applications.
  • Provide accurate and reliable estimates.
  • Consistently deliver work on time and of high quality.
  • Understand and work from business requirements documentation (user stories, use cases, as well as traditional software requirements specifications).
  • As a part of an agile project team, share technical and product knowledge with other team members.
  • Support and troubleshoot production deployments
  • Seek mentoring from senior team members as necessary

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of software development experience with object-oriented technologies
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field required.
  • Some knowledge of object-oriented design patterns, software architecture concepts, and web application constructs.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming languages and object-oriented architectures.
  • Some understanding of relational database technologies and experience writing SQL queries.
  • Possesses good written, oral communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to learn how to support production systems
  • Experience working with integrations such as web services or messaging is a plus.
  • Experience working as part of a high pace agile development team is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Guidewire technologies; PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, or ClaimCenter; required.
  • Knowledge and experience of the Guidewire object model.
  • Experience with both configuration as well as integration within the Guidewire architecture.
  • GOSU development skills.
  • Knowledge and experience with Guidewire typelists, rule sets, plugins, activities and messaging framework.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL server
  • Certification or Licenses
  • Comparable object-oriented technology certification a plus.

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. jobs.title: Sr. Loss Prevention Representative - Industrial Hygiene
jobs.description_html:
NJM Insurance Group, is a leading mid-sized U.S. property and casualty insurance company with 90 consecutive years of A+ financial strength ratings by AM BEST. Due to exceptional employee experience, NJM has been included on the latest Forbes List of Best Employers in New Jersey for the fourth year in a row. The NJM reputation for being a top provider of outstanding customer service was reaffirmed by the most recent J.D. Power Auto Insurance Claims Survey.


NJM has focused on a strategic plan that calls for it to become a regional property & casualty insurer and has transitioned away from its affinity-based membership model. To that end, the Company has added an independent agency model for new lines of middle and large commercial and has more than doubled its product offerings. NJM now offers its various products to businesses across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Delaware, and Connecticut.

NJM’s Commercial Lines department conducts business for policyholders and preferred agencies within the Mid-Atlantic region, specifically NJ, PA, NY, MD, DE, CT. Products include Commercial Auto, G/L, Workers Comp, BOP, Excess/Umbrella, and Package. The Commercial Lines function encompasses Underwriting, Sales, Operations, Premium Audit, Product Management, Product Development, Loss Prevention and Business Process Unit.

The Commercial Lines Loss Prevention team is searching for a Senior Loss Prevention Representative. The goal of the Sr. Loss Prevention Representative is to assist our policyholders in the process of identifying, quantifying, eliminating, or reducing the risk of loss.  This is a senior level position that will entail training and mentoring of staff.

** This position does not provide a company vehicle but NJM does reimburse for mileage and tolls.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

  • Conduct on-site loss control surveys and underwriting evaluations to assess potential hazards for our policyholders and agency partners

  • Conduct accident investigations

  • Prepares loss control reports and sends recommendations to policyholders to help them improve potential risk factors

  • A knowledge of workplace safety

  • An understanding of nationally recognized standards and codes

  • Develop, enhance and present training programs in the area of loss prevention

  • Communicate loss prevention services available to policyholders and agency partners

  • Will be responsible for mentoring loss prevention representatives in the department

  • May act on behalf of the loss prevention supervisor in their absence

  • May train other loss prevention representatives on conducting site evaluations, training, or other loss control services

Required Qualifications and Experience: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • 6+ years of experience in loss control including Industrial Hygiene

  • Air sampling and noise monitoring experience

  • High School Diploma/GED Required

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills

  • Ability to work in a team environment or independently

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and be detail-oriented

  • Excellent analytical and decision making skills

  • Experience with laptop computers as well as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook

  • Safety experience is required 

  • Loss Control and Safety Experience in the Insurance Industry (Workers’ Comp, Commercial Auto, Property and/or General Liability)

  • This position is the field and requires regular travel throughout the Central NJ area.

Preferred Qualifications:                                                                          

  • Bachelor's Degree is preferred

  • Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) preferred

  • OHST (Occupational Health and Safety) Certification Preferred

  • ARM (Associate in Risk Management) preferred

  • ASC (Advanced Safety Certification)

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $121,807-$141,453

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

jobs.description_html:
The Product Development Manager is responsible for supporting the design, enhancement, and ongoing management of NJM’s personal auto, homeowners, and umbrella products across the company’s operating footprint. This newly created position is accountable for evaluating product performance, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to improve product competitiveness and profitability. The role is also responsible for conducting research, developing recommendations, and collaborating with actuarial, underwriting, claims, compliance, IT, and other business areas to implement product changes and strategic initiatives. In addition, the position ensures alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives, contributing to product strategy and supporting NJM’s growth and performance goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.

Lead the creation & recommendation of new & existing product enhancements for assigned lines of business. Develop short & long-term project roadmaps for each product assigned. Work with key stakeholders to ensure alignment of product goals & objectives. Present recommendation for approval to senior leadership, up to and potentially including the Executive Leadership Team.

Proactively identify, evaluate, and recommend new product opportunities for assigned lines of business. Conduct comprehensive competitor research and other market solutions. Apply the analytical rigor model to determine best solution to successfully solve consumer pain points.

Oversee the successful execution of assigned product enhancements. Work closely with the SOG and PMO teams ensuring a timely implementation. Collaborate and provide support & guidance across Personal Lines in communicating changes to policyholders and staff.

Hours:
Monday through Friday, day shift

Compensation:
The salary is commensurate with experience and credentials but is likely to fall in the $175,000 - $215,000 range. This full time position is based in our suburban West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office, which is easily commutable from central and southern New Jersey as well as Bucks and Philadelphia Counties in Pennsylvania.

Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.

  • Minimum 4‑year college degree or equivalent
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in insurance product development, product management, actuarial, or analytics, with increasing responsibilities

  • Commitment to continuous learning, including product best practices and emerging technologies

This newly created position is accountable for evaluating product performance, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to improve product competitiveness and profitability. The role is also responsible for conducting research, developing recommendations, and collaborating with actuarial, underwriting, claims, compliance, IT, and other business areas to implement product changes and strategic initiatives. In addition, the position ensures alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives, contributing to product strategy and supporting NJM’s growth and performance goals.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Essential functions of this job are listed below in order of priority. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential duties. Regular and predictable onsite attendance is an essential function of the job.
 Lead the creation & recommendation of new & existing product enhancements for assigned lines of business. Develop short & long-term project roadmaps for each product assigned. Work with key stakeholders to ensure alignment of product goals & objectives. Present recommendation for approval to senior leadership, up to and potentially including the Executive Leadership Team.
 Proactively identify, evaluate, and recommend new product opportunities for assigned lines of business. Conduct comprehensive competitor research and other market solutions. Apply the analytical rigor model to determine best solution to successfully solve consumer pain points.
 Oversee the successful execution of assigned product enhancements. Work closely with the SOG and PMO teams ensuring a timely implementation. Collaborate and provide support & guidance across Personal Lines in communicating changes to policyholders and staff.
 Hours : 
Monday through Friday, day shift
 Compensation: 
The salary is commensurate with experience and credentials but is likely to fall in the $175,000 - $215,000 range. This full time position is based in our suburban West Trenton, New Jersey corporate office, which is easily commutable from central and southern New Jersey as well as Bucks and Philadelphia Counties in Pennsylvania.
 Required Qualifications: Knowledge, skills & abilities, experience, minimum & desired education, certification and/or license requirements.
 Minimum 4‑year college degree or equivalent
 Minimum 3–5 years of experience in insurance product development, product management, actuarial, or analytics, with increasing responsibilities
 Strong analytical abilities and natural curiosity for solving complex business challenges
 Advanced Excel and database skills; proficiency with MS Office suite
 Commitment to continuous learning, including product best practices and emerging technologies
 Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization

 College degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Insurance, or related field

jobs.title: Workers Compensation Claims Specialist, Sr
jobs.description_html:
NJM’s WC Claims Department is seeking an experienced Claims Specialist, Sr. who lives in Western or Central PA to provide on-site service to our policyholders and agents in that area.  This is a 100% remote position which includes virtual claims handling for customers in any area of PA and possibly MD, DE or CT as needed.  

At NJM, our WC Claims Department empowers our employees to focus on delivering guidance and empathy to our customers.  As a department driven by service and customer advocacy, we are committed to providing transparent, empathetic support and collaborative engagement during the life of a claim. The WC Claims Department takes pride in being a key component in the growth and success of our policyholders’ business operations.

To meet these expectations, WC Claims Specialists are supported by a dedicated call center who can field calls for them and other specialized units who are responsible for setting reserves, making permanency payments, and following through on subrogation so they can dedicate the time needed to manage claims. Many of our staff are long-tenured with a focus on building relationships, not only with our customers, but with each other providing a positive and nurturing work environment.

Hours:

Monday to Friday 8:00AM- 4:15PM (Hours can vary depending on start time).

Training is required at the NJM- West Trenton office.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure quality management of claims in accordance with claims best practices and company guidelines, and timely, accurate documentation of claim activity

  • Provide a high level of customer service that promotes injured worker advocacy-based principles to improve outcomes for all parties 

  • Determine compensability and coverage issues by gathering medical and factual evidence

  • Administer the delivery of timely, appropriate, and accurate benefits

  • Evaluate the claim for potential fraud indicators and escalate the claim to SIU, as appropriate

  • Recognize and investigate subrogation opportunity and refer to NJM subrogation staff for recovery of third-party funds

  • Initiate and provide excellent communication with all stakeholders (injured workers, medical providers, attorneys, policyholders, agents, etc.) professionally and proactively with a customer-centric approach

  • Apply critical thinking skills to evaluate and mitigate exposures, and establish and implement a proactive strategic plan of action

  • Assign and refer claim petitions to Counsel, and work to resolve the claim within given authority

  • Build rapport with policyholders and agents, conduct on-site investigations when necessary, and educate policyholders and agents on NJM procedures, policies, and claim practices

  • Prepare and attend Claim Reviews at policyholder or agent locations in Western and/or Central PA or virtually for further locations.

  • Serve as a liaison between policyholders/agents and various departments in NJM.

  • Represent WC Claim in on-site capabilities meetings to onboard new policyholders in Western and/or Central PA. 

  • Participate in training programs to keep current on relevant issues/topics

  • Recommend process improvement where applicable to best improve the department efficiency, work product, and service commitment to interested parties

  • Demonstrate a commitment to NJM’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and apply knowledge of compliance policies and procedures, standards, and laws applicable to job responsibilities in the performance of work

Required Qualifications and Experience:

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Workers' Comp Claim Representative, or comparable knowledge and experience with various aspects of claims handling and/or process including advanced knowledge of medical terminology and WC regulations for PA, MD and/or DE claims.

  • Knowledge of and/or experience working with liens and Medicare Set-Asides to secure full and final settlements

  • Customer service oriented with strong written and oral communication skills

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work both in a team and independently

  • Demonstrated organizational skills, and use of sound decision-making capabilities

  • Working knowledge utilizing an automated claim processing system and Microsoft Office tools including Word and Outlook

  • Licensed in DE and/or CT to adjust WC claims or have the ability to obtain these licenses within 90 days.

  • Ability to travel for business purposes, approximately 2 – 3 days a week meeting with policyholders and/or agents

Preferred:

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree

  • AIC/CPCU or other applicable insurance designations

  • Experience using Guidewire Claim Center, OnBase and additional Microsoft Office tools including Teams, Excel and PowerPoint

  • Knowledge and experience in claims handling for other commercial line products in various states including PA, MD and/or DE.

Salary:

  • Sr Level starting rate is $79,129.05+ annually based on experience and credentials

Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $79,129-$91,834

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

jobs.title: Category Manager – Travel, Meetings & Events
jobs.description_html:
We are seeking an experienced Sourcing Category Manager – Travel, Meetings & Events to join our Global Sourcing & Procurement organization. This role will support the Travel, Meetings & Events category, partnering with business stakeholders and suppliers to deliver competitive commercial outcomes, service excellence, supplier performance, innovation, and risk mitigation.

The ideal candidate will bring strong strategic sourcing and category management experience, preferably within corporate travel, meetings and events, hospitality, or related indirect services. This individual will be comfortable navigating a diverse supplier landscape that may include travel management companies, airlines, hotels, car rental and ground transportation providers, meetings and events agencies, venue sourcing partners, and travel and event technology providers.

Success in this role requires strong commercial and analytical skills, excellent stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to balance cost optimization with service quality, traveler and attendee experience, operational requirements, and business needs.

This role requires 4 days per week in our Atlanta office.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute category strategies across Travel, Meetings & Events, with a focus on cost optimization, service quality, supplier performance, innovation, risk management, and overall business value.
  • Lead strategic initiatives across areas such as corporate travel, travel management services, air, hotel, car rental, ground transportation, meetings and events services, venue sourcing, and travel and event technology.
  • Negotiate meetings and events services, including event management, venue sourcing, hotel and meeting-related agreements, event technology, and other supporting services.
  • Analyze category spend, supplier performance, market intelligence, and business requirements to identify opportunities for cost savings, cost avoidance, demand management, supplier optimization, process improvement, and innovation.
  • Monitor Travel, Meetings & Events market dynamics and emerging trends, including changes in air and hotel pricing, supplier capacity, technology, distribution models, and business travel and meetings trends, and translate those insights into sourcing strategies. Identify opportunities to improve the overall economics and effectiveness of the Travel, Meetings & Events program.
  • Partner with Travel, Meetings & Events program leadership, Finance, Legal, business stakeholders, regional teams, and other cross-functional partners to understand requirements and develop solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships and establish effective supplier governance through business reviews, KPI and SLA management, issue resolution, performance improvement, and innovation discussions.
  • Support both global and regional initiatives, taking into consideration differences in local markets, supplier capabilities, business requirements, and regulatory environments.
  • Partner with stakeholders to support adoption of preferred suppliers and maximize value from negotiated programs and agreements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, procurement, or a related discipline within a complex corporate environment.
  • Experience sourcing Travel, Meetings & Events, hospitality, or closely related indirect service categories strongly preferred.
  • Understanding of the corporate Travel, Meetings & Events supplier ecosystem, which may include travel management companies, airlines, hotels, car rental and ground transportation providers, meeting and event management companies, venue sourcing partners, and travel/event technology providers.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing sourcing strategies that deliver measurable cost savings, cost avoidance, service improvements, supplier innovation, and risk mitigation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with experience leveraging spend data, supplier data, benchmarking, market intelligence, and commercial analysis to inform sourcing decisions.
  • Ability to balance commercial objectives with service quality, operational requirements, and traveler and attendee experience.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships, influence decisions, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Strong supplier relationship management capabilities, including experience with KPIs, SLAs, supplier business reviews, performance management, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency with sourcing, procurement, contract management, spend analytics, and related technology platforms.



#LI-CY1

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Corporate Development
jobs.description_html:
Get to know the business

Within Finance, AIG’s Corporate Development team is responsible for the evaluation and execution of strategic transactions (e.g., acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, minority investments) and supporting the development of AIG’s business unit and enterprise-wide strategy.

 

About the role

The Corporate Development team is seeking a Senior Analyst to support the evaluation and execution of strategic transactions. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and quantitative skills and the ability to present complex information in a manner that supports executive decision-making. Additionally, the candidate must demonstrate excellent organizational and communications skills and the ability to deliver a high-quality work product in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

 

Responsibilities

Senior Analysts play an integral role on the Corporate Development team and while day-to-day responsibilities are diverse, core responsibilities include the following:

  • M&A Process Management: Develop workplans with detailed workstream-level status updates, maintain working group lists, draft meeting agendas and take meeting notes
  • Due Diligence: Maintain and update due diligence request lists and manage virtual data rooms. Liaise with subject matter experts from across AIG’s business units and functional areas (e.g., legal, tax, finance, etc.)
  • Financial Modeling & Valuation: Construct financial models and develop valuation and return analyses in support of transactions
  • Memorandums & Presentations: Prepare memorandums, presentations and comprehensive financial analyses for AIG’s senior management, Board of Directors and other key stakeholders
  • Strategy Development: Conduct in-depth research and analysis on insurance markets, lines of business/products, industry dynamics and emerging trends in support of AIG's strategy
  • Adhoc Requests: Perform ad hoc qualitative and quantitative analysis in support of other strategic initiatives
  • Competitive Benchmarking: Monitor financial and operational performance of insurance peers and potential acquisition targets

What we’re looking for

  • Highly motivated individual with strong attention to detail and ability to learn and work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Self-starter with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities
  • 1+ years of corporate development, management consulting, investor relations, investment banking, or related finance experience

jobs.description_html:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Underwriting Team Lead to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Lexington


AIG underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, Multinational Clients, and High Net Worth individuals. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model, and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact


  • Ability to exercise judgment, negotiate and make sound business decisions effectively based on increased level of authority.
  • Renders alternative outcomes for more difficult situations and makes real-time decisions in a fast-paced environment characterized by ambiguity and change.
  • Support consistent underwriting best practices, in accordance with underwriting guidelines, to ensure rating, pricing, profitability, and structuring adequacy.
  • Responsible for assigning and managing the work of a team of underwriters.
  • Assist underwriters in executing on strategic initiatives.  Provide support and develop solutions to their issues/concerns (system, guidelines, training, reports, new project request, product amendments). 
  • Assist underwriters in collaborating with Distribution, Territory Managers, and other line(s) of business underwriters to target desirable accounts and cross selling opportunities from brokers.
  • Utilize various daily reports and constant monitoring of adherence to underwriting requirements and guidelines to oversee assigned book of business.
  • Keep abreast of developments in assigned territories to determine their effect on current accounts and potential new business opportunities.
  • Work with management, the Insured, its broker and outside counsel on contract terms and conditions, as well as pricing, terms & conditions, and deal structure for complex risks.
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships with brokers and clients to profitably grow a book of business.
  • Identify the need for and manage special underwriting projects as needed.
  • Provide superior customer service to brokers and clients.
  • Produce, underwrite, manage and service a profitable book of business.

What you’ll need to succeed


  • Effective Team and People Manager, able to attract, engage, retain, and develop a high performing team to meet current and future business needs with ability to clearly articulate and execute plans.
  • Commercial Insurance Company, Agency or Brokerage experience
  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university preferred.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excess & Surplus Property line of business, including product features, forms, regulatory environment and risks etc.
  • Demonstrated sales, marketing, and relationship building experience.
  • Highly motivated and results oriented
  • Very strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in dynamic, rapidly changing environment, adapting to changing requirements and collaborating with a wide range of colleagues to quickly deliver solutions.
  • Proficient with underwriting analytical tools and technology.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Campaign Marketing
jobs.description_html:
About the role

This is an opportunity to join a high-impact marketing team focused on advancing key business priorities across North America Insurance.


We are seeking an experienced campaign strategist to join the North America Marketing team as its dedicated campaigns expert. This centralized role will partner with the Retail, Wholesale, Alternative Channels, and Distribution Marketing teams.


The Senior Marketing Manager, Campaigns will be the team’s resident expert on campaign architecture and strategy, bringing the knowledge and framework to determine the right campaign approach for each initiative, define audience and channel mix, and ensure every campaign is built with clear objectives and measurable outcomes. This includes distinguishing between awareness, nurture, retention, and conversion-focused programs and applying the right strategy for each business need.


Equally important, this role owns the campaign workflow and processes across the NA Marketing team, ensuring campaigns are well-briefed, properly sequenced, and executed efficiently, enabling the team to operate with speed and impact.


The role reports to the Chief Marketing & Communications Officer, North America Insurance.


The Senior Manager is a centralized resource and partner to all business line marketing leads across the North America Marketing team. This role manages a junior campaign specialist responsible for technical execution and marketing automation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the campaign strategy expert for the North America Marketing team. Partner with Retail, Wholesale, Distribution, and Alternative Channels marketing leads at the campaign planning stage to define objectives, shape briefs, and recommend the right campaign approach for each initiative
  • Develop strategic campaign frameworks, including nurture and drip campaigns, audience segmentation strategies, and client and broker communication journeys
  • Own the end-to-end campaign workflow process by designing, documenting, and continuously improving how campaigns are requested, briefed, reviewed and approved and handed off for execution.
  • Serve as the primary point of intake for campaign requests, ensuring all initiatives are properly scoped and briefed before moving to execution
  • Manage external agency relationships in support of campaign development and execution
  • Maintain a forward-looking campaign calendar to drive visibility, coordination, prioritization, and execution discipline across the North America marketing team
  • Track and report on campaign performance, bringing data-driven insights back to the team to inform future campaign decisions
  • Establish consistent campaign processes, governance, and ways of working across the organization
  • Stay current on B2B campaign best practices, marketing automation capabilities, and merging approaches relevant to the insurance and financial services sector
  • Remain current on emerging AI trends, tools, and best practices relevant to marketing and communications
  • Manage and mentor a junior marketing campaign team member, providing clear direction on technical execution, automation, and quality standards

Job Requirements:

  • 6+ years of B2B marketing experience with a strong focus on campaign strategy and execution
  • Strong understanding of campaign workflows, marketing operations, and how to build efficient and repeatable processes
  • Strong knowledge and fluency of marketing automation platforms, campaign management tools, and CRM systems, with a solid understanding of technical execution, even if not hands on day-to-day
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders and translate business objectives into clear, actionable campaign briefs
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across different business lines
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to guide and influence senior marketing colleagues on campaign strategy
  • Experience managing agency relationships

Education and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Data Science, Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing or related field). Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Eloqua, Salesforce CRM

For positions based in NYC, the base salary range is $114,000 - $159,000. For positions based in NJ, the base salary range is $109,000 - $152,000. For positions based in Illinois, the base salary range is $105,000 - $146,000 and the position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Are you looking for the next step in your career? Our Operational Support Specialist position is a great opportunity to join our growing team!


This role requires 4 days per week in our Jeffersonville, Indiana office.


Get to know the business

AIG is a leading provider of insurance products and services for commercial
and personal insurance customers. It includes one of the world’s most far-reaching property-casualty networks. AIG offers a broad range of products to customers through
a diversified, multi-channel distribution network.


Position Overview:

The Operations Support Specialist will work directly with Apple warranty customers, Apple, and our internal partners to find innovative service solutions to resolve issues & escalations.  The Ops Specialists help uphold our contracts appropriately while also ensuring an acceptable claim resolution.  They are a liaison between the client, customer, and service provider; they provide a World Class level of service for both internal and external customers.

As a contributor at AIG, the Ops Specialists are who our clients rely on to find an expedited solution for warranty customers that have an issue with a past or present service event.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop reporting on customer survey data and present results to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Work with Open Claims Management and Complaints teams to identify more streamlined reporting for their results that can be more easily reported to business stakeholders.
  • Take customer survey data along, with analytics from OCM and complaints, and implement IVR technology that will improve the customer experience.
  • Expand customer service surveys to as many programs and touch points as possible.
  • Support and lead special projects focused on improving the customer claim experience.
  • Create documentation that can be utilized to automate processes.
  • Handle inbound customer service and escalation calls from both customers and clients.
  • Communicates effectively with all levels within AIG Warranty, clients and/or vendors.
  • Organize and process claim paperwork as necessary.
  • Serve as liaison between customers, clients and/or vendors.
  • Responsible for processing replacement claims and handling/responding to back-orders in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Resolve client and customer claim issues; attempt to finalize issues within two days.

Skills/Experience Required:

  • 1+ year of work experience in a customer service support capacity; preferable in a service center environment.
  • Required high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Proficient with PC’s, especially with MS Word, Outlook, and Excel programs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work with a variety of personalities.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Previous customer service and/or phone experience.
  • Ability to multi-task and handle several issues simultaneously.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional attitude when dealing with escalated claims.
  • Ability to negotiate with customers and vendors.
  • Ability to coach and assist other team members in a professional manner.

Associate Actuary – A&H Pricing, North America

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Director & Actuary – A&H Pricing, North America to take on key responsibilities within a world-class actuarial function.


Make your mark in the A&H Actuarial Team

Our A&H Actuaries are on the front lines, quantifying risk, pricing insurance and providing key analyses for AIG’s stakeholders.  We collaborate with multiple functions, including Finance, Claims, Operations, Marketing and Underwriting.  As an AIG actuary, you will be challenged and encouraged to reach your greatest potential to help improve how we predict, manage and mitigate risk.


How you will create an impact

Your expertise in A&H risk management and pricing will be key in leading your team to provide technical pricing guidance, product development analytics, performance measurement and financial reporting, while ensuring alignment with regulatory standards and corporate goals in support of the A&H business.


Responsibilities include

  • Drive product innovation by collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring new products to market.  Your knowledge of A&H products and analytical techniques will ensure competitive design and pricing.
  • Assess and provide risk mitigation solutions to ensure alignment with corporate goals and regulatory standards.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership, influencing strategic decisions related to budget, product design, portfolio management, and business segments.
  • Mentor a team of actuaries and analysts, fostering a culture of collaboration and actuarial best practices.
  • Independently and effectively engage with various internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple projects such as:
  • Transformation projects for Pricing Management Reporting.
  • Budget and reinsurance planning. 

What we are looking for

  • BS in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related area.
  • ASA / ACAS Designation is preferred
  • At least 4+ years of actuarial experience, A&H pricing experience preferred.
  • Advanced experience with Excel, Python, and PowerPoint.
  • Knowledge with R and/or other data visualization software a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

For positions based in New York , the base salary range is $119,000-$149,000. For positions based in New Jersey, the base salary range is $115,000-145,000. The position is eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable incentive plan. Your actual compensation will be dependent on your skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition, we’re proud to offer a range of competitive benefits, a summary of which can be viewed here: US Benefits
