jobs.title: Claims Coverage Counsel/Claims Coverage Administrator
jobs.description_html:
Claims Coverage Counsel/Claims Coverage Administrator

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY

Merchants Insurance Group is a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast and is looking for an experienced Claims Coverage Counsel or Claims Coverage Administrator for our Corporate Claim Legal Team located in Buffalo, NY.

We are seeking individuals with previous experience in insurance coverage analysis/determination/disposition for at least five years.  While a law degree is preferred, we are also considering individuals without a law degree that have deep technical experience in significant and complex coverage scenarios to include New York construction/labor law and other commercial claims.

This position will be responsible for preparing coverage opinions and coverage position letters for claims involving complex coverage issues or disputes.  This role will also assist claims professionals in the evaluation of risk transfer opportunities, priority of coverage, and tender strategies.  Coverage Counsel/Coverage Administrator is responsible for assessing and directing coverage litigation strategy in conjunction with outside counsel and the claims professional, including developing and executing a plan to manage the coverage litigation through final resolution. This individual may also provide legal support to underwriting, product development and regulatory compliance programs (JD candidate only). 

This position is responsible for both first- and third-party coverage review, analysis and decisions for all levels of claims, including those involved in litigation. In addition, the individual will provide claim, policy, regulatory and legal expertise, if or as appropriate, to all levels of management up to and including senior management.   The role will also review all policy forms for updates and revisions, ensuring compliance with state regulations, as well as applicable statutes and case law.  The position will also require training for all levels of claims staff in matters of policy interpretation, investigatory processes, regulatory compliance and good faith claims practices across multiple venues.

Merchants Insurance Group is rated A- (Excellent) with a stable outlook by A.M. Best and is consistently recognized as a top employer and high-performing organization. Recent honors include:

  • Best Places to Work in Western New York (Buffalo Business First, 2023–2026)
  • New York #1 Commercial Insurer (Big I, New York 2026)
  • Fast Track Company (2019–2025) and Top Private Company (2019–2025)
  • Ward’s 50® top-performing property-casualty insurer (2021–2024)
  • Ivans Spark Award for Innovation (2024–2025)
  • Named to Newsweek and Statista’s America’s Most Reliable Companies list (2025), ranked among the top 300 of 1,500 B2B organizations evaluated

We offer a hybrid work schedule, requiring two full days per week in the office, with flexibility to work remotely or in office the remaining days. This model supports collaboration while providing flexibility and work-life balance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Prepares coverage communication consistent with internal quality standards and applicable state regulations.
  • Works collaboratively with front-line claims professionals and managers to provide coverage analysis and preparation or review of coverage position letters for claims involving complex coverage issues or disputes.
  • Provides legal or coverage guidance to claim professionals handling declaratory judgment actions in which Merchants is a named party.
  • Directs outside counsel on litigation strategy.
  • Leads claim staff in training involving legal or coverage matters.
  • Provides claim legal support to underwriting and product development teams. Also assists in regulatory compliance programs by providing supplementary research regarding statutes and regulations impacting our business.

 

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Juris Doctor degree preferred, with license in good standing
  • Minimum 5 years of insurance coverage experience and/or practicing attorney experience
  • Proficiency with Westlaw or other legal research applications CPCU highly desirable
  • Minimum 10 years of technical experience in complex coverage analysis
  • Prior leadership experience is highly desired
  • High degree of competency in insurance coverage analysis, policy construction, and legal research with exemplary writing skills.
  • Ability to transfer knowledge through formal and informal training with demonstrated excellent written and oral presentation skills.
  • Advanced written and oral communication skills with influence, initiative, and ability to communicate effectively across all levels across an insurance organization to include cross-departmental relationships.
  • Experience with construction and labor law litigation coverage issues related to risk transfer.
  • Proven demonstration of creative problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to lead and work in a cooperative manner.

Merchants Insurance Group Pay information:

Merchants Insurance Group offers a competitive pay scale.  The estimated salary for this role ranges from $100,000 - $160,000 based on leveling and geography, along with an equity component and a comprehensive benefits package.  This range is merely an estimate; actual compensation may deviate from this range based on skills, experience and qualifications.

 

Merchants Insurance Group Benefits:

  • Welcoming and positive work environment.
  • Colleague Appreciation Events.
  • Flexible work arrangements, including flex scheduling and summer hours.
  • Hybrid work schedule. The Hybrid work schedule will require 2 full days per week in the office, with the option of working the remaining days per month at home or in the office.
  • Competitive pay scale.
  • Generous paid time off package.
  • Full Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, 401(k) employer match amount is 100% up to 6% of your annual contributions. You are immediately 100% vested in the employer match dollars.
  • Outstanding company bonus program.
  • Tuition Reimbursement.

 

And many more exciting company benefits!!

Merchants Insurance Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Product Manager – Commercial Lines

Hybrid Work Schedule

Buffalo, NY 

At Merchants Insurance Group, we're looking for a strategic and results-oriented professional to help shape the future of our insurance product portfolio. As a Product Manager for commercial package and middle market, you will lead the performance, strategy, and growth of assigned product lines, driving initiatives that enhance profitability, improve loss outcomes, and strengthen our competitive position in the marketplace.

In this highly visible role, you'll collaborate across Underwriting, Actuarial, Claims, Distribution, and other key business areas to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful business results. Success requires a strong blend of analytical thinking, business acumen, and influence—leveraging data, expertise, and relationships to align stakeholders and execute winning strategies.

The ideal candidate brings product management experience within the insurance industry, a passion for data-driven decision-making, and the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with underwriting and/or actuarial experience will be especially well-positioned to thrive in this role.

If you're looking for an opportunity to make a measurable impact, collaborate with talented professionals, and help drive the continued success of Merchants Insurance Group, we encourage you to apply.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Product Strategy, Portfolio Management & Performance 

  • Serve as the business owner for assigned product lines, accountable for profitability, growth, retention, and overall portfolio performance
  • Drive production goals for assigned product lines by monitoring performance, partnering with regional teams to identify opportunities and challenges, and implementing targeted actions to improve results.
  • Conduct competitive, market, and industry analysis to identify emerging trends, customer demands, and strategic opportunities.
  • Lead state rate and form filings in partnership with Actuarial Team.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.

Product Development & Innovation 

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned products, from strategy and prioritization through implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversight of day-to-day management of assigned product lines, with hands-on involvement across all aspects of the product lifecycle.
  • Partner with technology and operational teams to improve product capabilities, streamline processes, and enhance customer and agent experience.
  • Analyzes performance across key dimensions and leverages insights to recommend and implement actions that improve results.
  • Identifies and develops new product opportunities, coverage enhancements, and endorsements to strengthen profitability and expand market presence.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Production Management

Buffalo, New York

Merchants Insurance Group is a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast and is looking for an experienced Director, E&S Specialty Business, to join our Corporate Headquarters located in Buffalo, New York.

The Director, E&S Specialty Business is a member of the Management Team and is responsible for providing leadership for all program business across the organization, with full accountability for the performance, growth, and profitability of the book. This role is responsible for driving the success of our program portfolio by partnering closely with external managing general agents, program administrators, reinsurers, brokers, and internal business units to deliver differentiated products and services.

  • Lead the vision, direction, and ongoing management of all corporate program initiatives, ensuring strong alignment with enterprise growth objectives.

  • Flexible work arrangements, including flex scheduling and summer hours.

Reserving Actuarial Analyst

Hybrid work schedule

Buffalo, NY

Merchants Insurance Group, a leading Property and Casualty Insurer in the Northeast, is looking for a Reserving Actuarial Analyst for our Corporate Actuarial team based in our Corporate Headquarters in Buffalo, New York.  

The Reserving Actuarial Analyst will become part of a dedicated actuarial team focusing on estimating unpaid property and casualty insurance liabilities and providing reserving methodology and process improvements

Merchants Insurance Group is rated A- (Excellent) with a stable outlook by A.M. Best and is consistently recognized as a top employer and high-performing organization. Recent honors include:

  • Best Places to Work in Western New York (Buffalo Business First, 2023–2026)
  • Fast Track Company (2019–2025) and Top Private Company (2019–2025)
  • Ward’s 50® top-performing property-casualty insurer (2021–2024)
  • Ivans Spark Award for Innovation (2024–2025)
  • Named to Newsweek and Statista’s America’s Most Reliable Companies list (2025), ranked among the top 300 of 1,500 B2B organizations evaluated

We offer a hybrid work schedule, requiring two full days per week in the office, with flexibility to work remotely or onsite the remaining days. This model supports collaboration while providing flexibility and work-life balance.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Supports quarterly and annual reserve reviews using traditional property-casualty unpaid claim estimation techniques and methodologies and implements the results effectively.
  • Extracts, validates, and maintains transactional datasets for both internal use and transfer to the Appointed Actuary.
  • Creates new or improves existing documentation, processes, and reports.
  • Improves tools and efficiency of the review process and prepares reserve summary reports for various internal and external stakeholders.
  • Leads reinsurance data call completion and streamlines data capture; monitors and updates reinsurance data year-round. 

 

 

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, or related field.
  • A minimum of three years’ experience in the property and casualty actuarial field is preferred.

  • Demonstrates general programming and/or database skills; SQL experience is preferred.

SUMMARY 

 

Leads the functional product and program delivery effort for the CRM Product Group at Alliant while serving as the senior role for the Salesforce platform. Manages the intake process for new requests and is responsible for coordinating the multi-year Salesforce product roadmap, prioritizing the product backlog with alignment and buy[1]in from the CRM Product Group Steering Committee, and ensuring delivery of high-quality, value-driven solutions that support the company's strategic goals. Partners closely with business stakeholders and the technical delivery organization to translate business priorities into executable plans and measurable outcomes.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Serve as the senior role and primary functional point of contact for Salesforce initiatives, managing the product backlog and prioritizing work based on business value, strategic objectives, stakeholder needs, and CRM Product Group Steering Committee alignment.

Collaborate with executives, Producers, Sales teams, Sales Operations, customer service, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, shape Salesforce vision and strategy, and coordinate a multi-year product roadmap and adoption plan.

Bring forward significant business value through creative solutioning; proactively identify opportunities to improve delivered CRM products, streamline the Producer experience, increase Producer productivity, strengthen Salesforce adoption, and improve the velocity and close rate of Opportunities.

Own and coordinate product and program execution across Salesforce initiatives, including roadmap sequencing, delivery planning, dependencies, risks, milestones, stakeholder communications, and business readiness.

Delegate facilitation of Agile ceremonies to Scrum Masters while providing Product Owner direction, priorities, decisions, and context needed for effective sprint planning, daily coordination, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous delivery improvement.

Partner closely with Salesforce developers, administrators, technical architects, DevSecOps resources, Salesforce Solution Architects, Business Architects, and other technical partners to ensure solutions meet business requirements and adhere to applicable standards and best practices

Review and approve solution designs from a business and product perspective, ensuring proposed solutions align with the Salesforce roadmap, business requirements, user experience expectations, and intended business outcomes.

Lead and coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), business readiness, stakeholder feedback, defect

prioritization, and business acceptance activities to continuously improve the Salesforce platform and support quality releases.

Provide leadership and governance for quality assurance activities, including test strategy, test planning,

regression coverage, release quality, defect management, and coordination between QA, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.

Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and outcome measures for Salesforce initiatives, with particular focus on platform adoption, Producer productivity, stakeholder satisfaction, and team engagement.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation within the CRM Product Group and across functional delivery teams.

Lead and directly manage a multidisciplinary team that includes Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Salesforce

Solution Architects, Business Architects, and Quality Assurance professionals, providing clear direction, coaching, support, and accountability for team success.

Exercise full people-management responsibility, including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, goal setting, regular one[1]on-one meetings, performance management, compensation and promotion recommendations, career development, succession planning, and employee engagement.

Manage team capacity and resource allocation across Salesforce initiatives, balancing priorities and aligning Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Architects, and QA resources to the highest-value work.

Provide leadership and direction to Functional Project Team Members like QA, Solutioning, and Scrum Masters; responsible for program and project execution, ensuring plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, scope, and stakeholder communications remain aligned to product priorities and roadmap outcomes.

Present Salesforce product strategy, roadmap, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to business

stakeholders and senior leadership; coordinate changes when priorities, dependencies, or business direction require adjustment.

Act as the functional delivery counterpart to the technical delivery organization, fostering strong collaboration and communication across product, program, architecture, engineering, administration, DevSecOps, quality assurance, Sales Operations, and business leadership.

Manage supplemental and temporary resources and related vendor performance as needed to support delivery capacity and business priorities.

Empower team members to take ownership of their work while maintaining focus on business value, customer outcomes, quality, collaboration, and timely delivery.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field; or an

equivalent combination of education and experience.

Five (5) or more years of experience in Salesforce product ownership, product management, program

management, or a similar platform leadership role, with significant responsibility for Salesforce strategy, roadmap, backlog, and delivery.

Four (4) or more years of experience managing product backlogs and leading Agile development teams

Three (3) or more years of direct people-management experience, including performance management, coaching, career development, hiring, and development of multidisciplinary teams.

One (1) or more years of experience working as a member of a SAFe Agile Release Train or comparable scaled Agile delivery model

Five (5) or more years of direct people-management experience in a product, program, architecture, quality assurance, or technology delivery environment

Four (4) or more years of experience in the insurance industry

Salesforce Certified Business Analyst

Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant

Salesforce Certified Administrator

Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder

SKILLS

Strong understanding of Salesforce capabilities, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and Lightning Experience.

Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and experience applying Agile practices in a product development environment.

Advanced knowledge of product management, program management, project management, roadmap planning, backlog management, release planning, and adoption practices.

Proficient in Microsoft Office products.

Strong leadership and people-management skills, including coaching, mentoring, goal setting, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and team engagement.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven product, program, and

prioritization decisions.

Excellent stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to build alignment among Sales, business leaders, functional teams, and technical delivery partners.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels and influence cross-functional decision-making.

Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams spanning project/program management, Agile delivery, solution architecture, business architecture, and quality assurance.

Proven ability to foster teamwork, empower ownership, drive accountability, and create a high-performing culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement.

objectives into executable delivery plans and measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Engineer III
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

 

Responsible for being the senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and improving infrastructure services that support Alliant Insurance Services, Inc. at scale. This role leads technical workstreams, mentors junior engineers, and drives measurable improvements in reliability, security, and operational efficiency. The engineer strengthens the organization's security posture by defining secure standards, proactively reducing risk, and ensuring systems are resilient and auditable. Success requires deep troubleshooting ability, strong project leadership, and disciplined operational practices.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

 

Lead infrastructure projects from design through implementation, including scope definition, risk assessment, stakeholder updates, and post-implementation validation.

Serve as a primary escalation point for complex incidents; coordinate cross-team troubleshooting and drive root cause analysis and permanent fixes.

Design and maintain secure configuration baselines for servers and core services; validate compliance and remediate drift.

Own patching and lifecycle strategies for assigned platforms, including prioritization based on vulnerability severity and business impact.

Develop system-specific operational policies and runbooks; ensure procedures are clear, tested, and adopted by the team.

Mentor and coach Systems Engineer I–II staff through pairing, reviews, and skills development plans; provide feedback on execution quality.

Implement automation to reduce manual work (provisioning, reporting, health checks, maintenance tasks) and improve consistency.

Plan and execute backup and disaster recovery strategies for assigned services; lead resiliency testing and track remediation to closure.

Partner with Security to respond to audits, vulnerability assessments, and control reviews; provide evidence and implement corrective actions.

Evaluate and recommend infrastructure tools and services; perform technical validation, proof-of-concept work, and implementation planning.

Collaborate with Network, Cloud, Application, and Service Desk teams to ensure end-to-end service reliability and secure integration patterns.

Produce clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and decision records to support operations and knowledge transfer.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

 

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Five (5) or more years of systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a closely related role

Demonstrated experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring junior team members.


Experience with cloud hybrid architectures and identity integrations.

Experience with compliance frameworks and audit evidence collection in regulated environments.

Advanced experience with Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, or related platform technologies.

Experience designing hybrid connectivity, identity integration, observability, backup, recovery, or platform security patterns.

Experience in insurance, financial services, regulated environments, or complex enterprise technology organizations.


Role-aligned certifications (Microsoft, VMware, Linux, cloud provider, or security-focused credentials).

SKILLS

 

Strong administration and engineering experience in Windows Server and/or Linux, including performance tuning and advanced troubleshooting.

Proven ability to design and implement infrastructure services (identity components, management tools, monitoring, endpoint or server management platforms).

Competence with infrastructure automation (PowerShell, Bash, and/or configuration tools) with a focus on repeatability and auditability.

Strong understanding of security fundamentals for infrastructure: hardening, secure authentication, logging, vulnerability remediation, and privileged access controls.

Experience leading projects and coordinating stakeholders; able to translate technical tradeoffs into business impacts.

Excellent documentation skills: can produce runbooks and diagrams that others can reliably follow.

Ability to define operational metrics and improve them (availability, incident volume, time to recovery, patch compliance).

#LI-DR2

#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Cloud Systems Administrator III
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

 

Responsible for leading technical initiatives and owning critical infrastructure components end-to-end. This role drives stability and security improvements by designing implementation plans, standardizing configurations, and mentoring junior administrators. The administrator strengthens Alliant's security posture through disciplined patch governance, secure-by-default configurations, and effective incident response leadership. Systems Administrator III is expected to reduce operational risk by improving automation, monitoring, and recovery readiness.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Serve as a technical lead for infrastructure projects (server modernization, platform upgrades, identity improvements) including planning, implementation, validation, and transition to operations.

Own administration of assigned systems/services, including lifecycle management, performance, capacity, and security posture.

Lead incident response for system-related events: coordinate troubleshooting, drive root cause analysis, and ensure durable corrective actions.

Develop and maintain system standards (build templates, hardening baselines, naming conventions, access models) and ensure consistent adoption.

Improve patch and vulnerability remediation processes by defining schedules, exception handling, and reporting to stakeholders.

Design and execute backup/restore and DR test plans; validate recovery objectives and document results and remediation actions.

Implement automation to reduce manual work and error risk (scripted provisioning, standardized checks, automated reporting).

Partner with Security to implement and validate controls (privileged access workflows, logging requirements, configuration baselines).

Review and approve changes for technical completeness, risk, and rollback readiness; coach others on change quality.

Mentor Systems Administrator I/II staff through hands-on training, peer review, and troubleshooting guidance.

Manage vendor support engagements for assigned platforms; coordinate escalations and track remediation to closure.

Produce high-quality documentation and diagrams suitable for operational handoff and audit review.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent experience.

Five (5) or more years in systems administration, including ownership of production systems and leading technical workstreams.

Experience with hybrid environments (on-prem + cloud) and identity integration patterns.

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code concepts and tools.

Demonstrated experience improving operational metrics (reducing incidents, improving patch compliance, shortening recovery times).

Experience supporting regulated environments and leading audit response for infrastructure controls.

Experience with Azure, AWS, Google Cloud operations in a multi-account or multi-subscription enterprise environment.

Experience with cloud monitoring, log analytics, backup, security posture, policy compliance, cost management, and automation tools.

Experience in insurance, financial services, regulated environments, or enterprise shared services.

SKILLS

Advanced administration of Windows Server and core infrastructure services; solid Linux administration ability.

Strong identity and access management experience (directory services, group policy strategy, privilege separation).

Proven ability to lead troubleshooting for complex issues across systems, storage, and network dependencies.

Experience designing and implementing standard builds and secure baselines.

Strong change management execution and risk assessment skills.

Automation proficiency (PowerShell required; ability to structure scripts/modules for reuse and peer review).

Ability to mentor and lead through influence (not just “do the work,” but level up the team).

Excellent communication: concise incident updates, stakeholder-friendly post-incident summaries, and clear technical documentation.

Comfort working across teams (Security, Network, Cloud, App Owners) to drive outcomes.

#LI-DR2

#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for leading the workplace accommodations process, partnering with employees, HR Business Partners, Legal, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, compliant, and employee-centric solutions. This role will also help drive scalable programs, policies, and resources that support an inclusive workplace while ensuring compliance with applicable employment laws.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

Serve as the primary point of contact for employees and candidates regarding workplace accommodation requests.

Lead interactive discussions by conducting thorough and respectful accommodation intakes with employees, including gathering information about job limitations, essential job functions, and potential workplace solutions.

Manage a high volume of confidential accommodation cases from intake through implementation, documentation, and follow-up.

Evaluate accommodation requests in accordance with applicable ADA requirements and company policies.

Obtain, review, and appropriately manage supporting medical documentation when necessary and permitted.

Identify potential reasonable accommodations and assess their effectiveness, feasibility, and impact on business operations.

Partner with HR and management to evaluate job functions, including assessing the “essential functions" of a role.

Coordinate accommodation-related leave requests with the internal Leave of Absence (LOA) administrator.

Research and recommend appropriate workplace accommodations, assistive technologies, and workplace modifications in partnership with Facilities, vendors, and other cross-functional teams, as needed.

Consult with HR leadership, Legal, and other appropriate partners on complex, high-risk, or potentially disputed accommodation matters.

Draft and send written correspondence regarding accommodation decisions, including approval, denial, requests for additional information, temporary arrangements, and changes to existing accommodations.

Maintain accurate and confidential records of all accommodation requests, communications, decisions, and follow-up activities, including periodic check-ins with employees to assess effectiveness and determine whether adjustments are needed.

Track accommodation cases, deadlines, expiration dates, review periods, and required follow-up actions.

Partner with the broader Employee Relations team on cases involving performance management, investigations, behavioral concerns, or other workplace matters.

Provide guidance and education to managers and HRBPs on the accommodation process, confidentiality, documentation, and appropriate workplace communication.

Help develop and maintain accommodation procedures, templates, tracking tools, training materials, and reporting to develop consistent employee experience.

Support audits and provide reporting on accommodation activity while protecting confidential employee information.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Five (5) or more years of Employee Relations experience with significant responsibility for workplace accommodations.

Experience partnering with HR, Legal, managers, and leave administrators throughout the interactive process.

Experience with ADA accommodations in a multi-state or multi-location organization.

Experience partnering with HR Business Partners, Leave, Legal, Employee Relations, and business leaders.

Experience with accommodation or leave-management platforms.

Experience creating manager guidance, training, and process documentation.


HR certification such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR.

SKILLS

Strong knowledge of U.S. and state specific accommodation and leave laws (e.g., ADA, FMLA, CFRA)

Knowledge of state and local disability accommodation requirements

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex or sensitive decisions clearly and professionally

Strong organization and case-management skills with the ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and competing priorities

Proficiency with HRIS, case-management, document-management, and Microsoft Office tools

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for providing analytical support to the Alliant Retail P&C Chief Financial Officer (CFO), their team and Alliant Retail leadership, with an emphasis on data analysis. Key responsibilities include management reporting and analysis, data reconciliation, process improvement, and supporting the administration of the Cross-Sell program and validation of program results.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides broad analytical support to assigned operating group(s) and acts as a liaison between team and other operational departments.

Analyzes and interprets financial results, comparing actual performance to prior periods, budgets, and forecasts. Clearly articulates to management the narrative behind the numbers.

Designs and prepares ad hoc and standard management reporting.

Proactively seeks opportunities to provide increasingly insightful reports to management.

Independently constructs moderate to complex financial models to analyze the impact of current and proposed company initiatives.

Organizes and analyzes large quantities of data including complex data sets used to support administration of the Cross-Sell program. Maintains accurate records, reconciles data, and validates reported results against source data to ensure the accuracy of work products.

Identifies and interprets patterns and outliers in the data set and provides insight into the meaning of the data.

Partners with IT, Salesforce staff, and other operational departments to develop and maintain the integrity of financial and other enterprise systems and platforms used for reporting and analysis

Proactively identifies areas for process improvement and implements methods to reduce error rates and maximize productivity and efficiency.

Perform all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Mathematics or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years related work experience; specifically in a FP&A role

Strong understanding of financial computer systems and data systems

Experience with Salesforce, Power BI or equivalent, and Applied Epic (insurance CRM)- Preferred

Graduate degree or professional certification- Preferred

Certified Corporate FP&A Professional- Preferred

Certified Public Accountant (CPA)- Preferred

Certified Financial Planner-CFP Board- Preferred



SKILLS

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, polished presentation skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office products, with advanced Excel skills and familiarity with Access

Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills

Strong ability to interpret and analyze financial statements

Strong mathematical ability

Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent assignments and complete work by required due dates

Ability to interact professionally with employees across all levels of organization

Technical understanding of data structure, data mining and reporting processes

Highly proactive; actively seeks opportunities for process improvement

Works independently with minimal supervision and as a member of a team

#LI-REMOTE

#LI-EA1

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist - Insurance
jobs.description_html:
Alliant is Hiring an Onboarding Specialist out of our Sequent  Planning office in Omaha, Nebraska!

Sequent Planning is a Registered Investment Adviser (RIA), which is a firm registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and state regulators to provide financial and investment advice.

 Office Location -8807 Indian Hills Drive, Omaha, NE 6811


SUMMARY 

Responsible for performing the program administration process for field advisors to support the needs of our expanding field network.  



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Advisor Program Administration: Coordinates all aspects of the 1099 advisor and Field Management onboarding process including initial set-up, coordination through the various stages including background checks, and coordination with commissions department on contract terms, contract changes and contract terminations. This includes tracking recruits through the designated programs, such as JobScore and
FastStart; training and advising Office Administrators, GMs, GSMs and other field and home office support team members with the processes and procedures; maintaining recruiting portal(s). Maintains other records, reports and logs pertaining to advisor applicant flow procedures; Compiles reports as needed. Communication with branch management and home office will be a frequent task to make sure all items are completed and tracked; dedication to obtaining the quickest possible approval for advisors through the process.   Interface with the appropriate internal and external parties for registered rep appointments with the designated broker dealer.


Contracting & Appointment Processing Functions: Assist with the contracting and appointment processing functions including submitting all required agent completed contracting paperwork to the carriers of our platform along with process follow up’s and confirmations.  Confirmation of in good order state licensing, carrier appointment, state training course completion, carrier course completion, suitability training course completion are all under the  Contracting & Appointment Processor team duties. Follow up regularly with carriers to check on the status of pending applications and confirm that all required materials have been received and are being reviewed.


Special Projects:  Work collaboratively with fellow staff to advance the values and mission of Sequent Planning by serving on relevant internal and external committees; Assists with special projects/assignments as requested by members of management.


Performs other duties as assigned by management.


QUALIFICATIONS 

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree


One (1) or more years of general insurance and/or contracting & appointment processing in an agency and/or carrier setting with life and annuity carriers/products.


Two (2) or more years of customer service experience.


Proficient with Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook.



SKILLS


Knowledge of human resource principles and practices; general office forms, processes and procedures; and the general industry procedures, practices and terminology.


Working knowledge of insurance services industries.


Knowledge of the general industry procedures, practices and terminology.


Skill in identifying problems and problem resolution.


Skill in working effectively with other company departments, internal marketing staff, home office personnel and agents.


Skill in negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.


Skill in the use of office equipment including computer, fax, printer, scanner, telephone system, etc.


Skill in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.


Proficient computer skills (Microsoft Suite, MS Outlook software preferred).


Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, in a constructive manner.


Ability to approach and communicate with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.


Ability to be patient under frustrating circumstances and demonstrate controlled emotional affect in difficult situations.


Ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.


Ability to maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail while remaining flexible and responsive when faced with multiple urgent requests.


Ability to read, write and communicate English effectively.


Ability to maintain all company policies, including all confidentiality and safety policies.


Ability to actively contribute to team effort.


Ability to work independently and exercise independent judgment.


Strong verbal and written proficiencies of the English language is required and bilingual (Spanish and English) preferred.




#LI-GS1

jobs.title: Commercial Lines Account Manager
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

 

Responsible for providing customer service and overall service of assigned customers and/or policies, soliciting of new business on existing accounts and support of Producer-led new business efforts.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

 

Supports Producer in developing new business opportunities for existing clients and prospects;

Initiates renewal process for existing clients, and discusses and creates renewal strategy with Producer;

Analyzes and compares current exposures and develops renewal or new business specifications for marketing;

Conducts marketing, negotiates rates, reviews quotes and coverages for competitiveness and accuracy;

Reviews and summarizes marketing results and prepares proposals;

Finalizes proposals and presentations in coordination with Producer;

Binds insurance coverage and prepares binders and/or delegate certificates issuance;

Reviews policies for accuracy and review contracts;

Prepares summaries and/or schedules of coverage for clients;

Reviews client accounting history, responds to accounting inquiries, corrects discrepancies, and contacts client on receivable collections;

Participates in the claims process as directed by management, including claim submission, follow-up and overall communication;

Provides technical guidance to staff assisting with client needs or procedural issues;

Notifies brokers of pertinent information related to client retention;

Meets with clients as needed or directed by Producer;

Collection of fees, reconciliation and resolution of any outstanding balances within 90 days of invoicing date;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

jobs.description_html:

Responsible for execution of all advanced pricing and analysis requests.  Leads in the development and management of assigned underwriting and analyst teams.

Act as subject matter expert in all major areas of underwriting, including special pricing and marketing projects.

Meet with clients and Financial & Underwriting team to define and accomplish projects.

Assist in determining strategic goals of team(s), including but not limited to resource planning, education/training needs, policy development, and business growth.

Bachelor's Degree Or equivalent combination of education and experience 

Eight (8) or more years of related work experience

One (1) or more years of management experience in leading a team of at least 3 individuals


Must continue to meet Continuing Education requirements for license renewal

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Excellent problem solving and time management skills

Ability to work productively as an individual to accomplish assigned projects

Responsible for ensuring that the overall process improvement activities produce high quality interactions with the clients and produce efficiencies in operations. Develops programs to review and evaluate BA team engagement to ensure service delivery is consistent with the Benefits ABC practice's standards.  Perform quality monitoring of Benefit Advocate (BA) team recordings, live calls, chats, emails and reports to determine customer trends and issues that relate to the customer's overall experience.

jobs.title: Client Services Executive
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for independently managing client relationships and delivering strategic consulting services related to value-based contracting with healthcare providers. Leads the day-to-day service and strategic relationship management of assigned health plan and provider accounts, coordinating resources to deliver measurable client value accross the policy term

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Responsible for the day-to-day management of assigned health plan and provider accounts in a client-facing capacity.

Contributes to relationship development and long-term account growth between Alliant and each client.

Helps develop a three-year reinsurance strategy for each client, informed by loss ratios, benchmarking, loss development, and targeted premium and rate goals.

Coordinates the implementation of Alliant resources, including Risk IQ, Actuarial, Clinical, Claims, and Service teams.

Coordinates installation meetings with the carrier, client, and Alliant service team to establish a smooth support model for each new policy term.

Develops an annual service calendar for each client, including quarterly client touchpoints.

Oversees premium and enrollment tracking with staﬀ support.

Maintains client tracking for key account components, including updated DOFRs, policy changes, and client staﬀ and leadership changes.

Partners with the Claims team to ensure client needs are addressed promptly and eﬀectively.

Coordinates with claims team to ensure policy is meeting claims adjudication outcomes.

Manages all policy reporting and ﬁnal submission requirements.

Oversees client data requests/needs throughout the policy term.

Owns assigned carrier renewals and new-business marketing within the health plmarkets.

Processes BOR requests for both renewals and new business.

Shares responsibility with the market leader for all pre-renewal meetings.

Leads proposal generation to include service summaries, claims recoveries, key other relevant KPIs.

Communicates renewal timelines, milestones, and expectations to clients.

Participates in managed-care conferences and industry events.

Travels as needed for face-to-face client meetings.

Supports new business meetings as needed both virtually and in person.

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Ten (10) or more years of experience in Managed Care Reinsurance

Valid Insurance License

SKILLS

 

Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgement in solving complex business problems.

Excellent analytical, financial, and strategic thinking skills.

Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive decision-making.

Advanced in Microsoft Office Suite.

Excellent time management skills.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to prioritize work for multiple tasks and deadlines.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

#LI-AS1

jobs.title: Divisional Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for providing analytical support to operating group leadership and team. Key responsibilities include management reporting and analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and process improvement.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Provides broad analytical support to assigned departments and acts as a liaison between departments.


Analyzes and interprets financial results, comparing actual performance to prior periods, budgets, and forecasts; then clearly articulates to management the narrative behind the numbers.


Designs and prepares ad hoc and standard management reporting.


Proactively seeks opportunities to provide increasingly insightful reports to management.


Independently constructs moderate to complex financial models to analyze the impact of current and proposed company initiatives.


Leads the forecasting and budgeting processes.


Creates and maintains planning templates and reports, helps to construct revenue and expense plans, identifies and analyzes variances, challenges and redirects business assumptions as needed.


Organizes and analyzes large quantities of data and performs data reconciliations to ensure accuracy of work products.


Identifies and interprets patterns and outliers in the data set and provides insight into the meaning of the data.


Partners with IT to develop and maintain integrity of financial systems used for analysis.


Proactively identifies areas for process improvement and implements methods to reduce error rates and maximize productivity and efficiency.


Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Mathematics or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience


Five (5) or more years related work experience; specifically in a FP&A role


Strong understanding of financial computer systems and data systems


Graduate degree or professional certification


Certified Corporate FP&A Professional


Certified Public Accountant (CPA)


Certified Financial Planner-CFP Board

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, polished presentation skills


Proficient in Microsoft Office products, with advanced Excel skills and familiarity with Access


Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills


Strong ability to interpret and analyze financial statements


Strong mathematical ability


Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent assignments and complete work by required due dates


Ability to interact professionally with employees across all levels of organization


Technical understanding of data structure, data mining and reporting processes


Highly proactive; actively seeks opportunities for process improvement


Works independently with minimal supervision and as a member of a team

jobs.title: ServiceNow Platform Architect (Remote)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for leading the design and delivery of transformational platform implementations. This role will partner directly with IT leadership, ServiceNow developer teams, and business stakeholders to translate organizational imperatives into scalable, value-driven ServiceNow solutions. This is a leadership-focused role that bridges technical excellence with strategic business outcomes and platform health/performance. You will also engage with implementation partners, participate in internal governance boards, and work across IT and business functions to drive platform adoption and sustainable value realization.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead end-to-end ServiceNow architecture, solution design, and implementation strategy; own the platform roadmap from discovery through go-live and optimization.

Direct delivery teams (developers, functional analysts, administrators, testers) on complex, multi-module implementations (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, GRC, FSO, etc.); ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices and platform governance.

Engage C-suite (CIO, CTO, CFO, business unit leaders), IT leadership (Senior Directors, Directors, Release Train Engineers), and cross-functional business stakeholders to define strategic platform vision, business outcomes, and change management; serve as the trusted technical advisor on ServiceNow strategy and organizational impact.

Define scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions for ServiceNow modules, integrations, and custom applications.

Design platform architecture, data models, integration patterns, and data governance frameworks aligned with client regulatory and operational requirements in partnership with other IT teams.

Collaborate with IT project managers and business analysts to translate business requirements into ServiceNow solution designs and detailed user stories.

Ensure solution alignment with enterprise architecture, business needs, and platform best practices.

Review technical design documents, data models, and integration patterns for quality and compliance.

Lead scope management, risk mitigation, and escalation resolution on complex implementations; drive accountability for schedule, technical quality, and business outcomes.

Partner with IT project managers, implementation partners, developers, and systems integrators; coordinate delivery across internal and external teams to ensure alignment, knowledge transfer, and sustainable handoffs.

Assess existing ServiceNow instances (e.g., CMDB/CSDM health, configuration debt, data model governance, upgrade readiness); recommend remediation and optimization strategies.

Participate in and/or lead governance boards, steering committees, and strategy forums; serve as the primary escalation point for technical strategy, business alignment, and change management decisions.

Develop proof-of-concept demonstrations, technical specifications, and detailed business cases quantifying platform value and organizational outcomes

Coach and mentor junior architects, functional leads, and delivery teams on ServiceNow best practices, design patterns, and implementation methodology


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree in computer technology or equivalent combination of education and experience

Eight (8) or more years of experience in ServiceNow Platform Expertise (Primary Focus), preferably in ServiceNow solution architecture, implementation, and delivery.

Eight (8) or more years of hands-on experience designing and implementing ServiceNow solutions across multiple product lines (ITSM, CSM, HRSD, GRC, FSO, SAM, or equivalent)

ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA)

Certified Master Architect (CMA)

Enterprise Architecture Certification


SKILLS

Strong experience with ServiceNow Financial Services Operations (FSO), Software Asset Management (SAM) modules, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), SPM, or AI.

Strong knowledge of core ServiceNow platform capabilities: application configuration, scripting (JavaScript, Glide), integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, MuleSoft), workflow design, and data modeling

Strong written communication; ability to develop compelling business cases, technical specifications, executive summaries, and board presentations

Ability to manage delivery teams (5-50 people across functional and technical disciplines); drive accountability for schedule, quality, and business outcomes

Ability to utilize ServiceNow capabilities: Now Intelligence, AI Search, Workflow Data Fabric, or Process Optimization

Skilled at leading 3+ complex, multi-year ServiceNow implementations from design through go-live and post-go-live optimization

Skilled at distilling complexity into clear narratives; ability to quantify platform value and organizational impact (operational efficiency, cost reduction, business process improvement)

Skilled with consulting or systems integrator background, advising clients on platform strategy

Experience with published thought leadership (blog posts, industry papers, conference presentations) on ServiceNow implementation or digital transformation

Knowledge of core commercial business functions and workflows that ServiceNow supports (finance, operations, IT service delivery, HR)

Knowledge of Bravium and the governance platform

Knowledge of multi-divisional or multi-geography operating models and how ServiceNow scales across complex organizational structures



#LI-DR2

#LI-REMOTE

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - Internal Audit (Remote)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for evaluating and enhancing the efficacy of risk management practices, internal controls, and governance processes across the organization. This role will work closely with leadership to develop and implement a comprehensive risk-based audit plan.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Executes the enterprise-wide annual risk assessment process and assists in developing the annual audit plan incorporating management insights, emerging trends, and regulatory changes within the industry.


Leads the full audit lifecycle (planning, execution, reporting, and remediation status) for financial, compliance, and operational audits.


Prepares timely and comprehensive audit reports to communicate results and recommendations to management.


Develops recommendations to strengthen internal controls, improve business processes, and verify that proper internal control safeguards are in place.


Fosters collaboration among team members and business partners throughout the organization.


Participates in advisory reviews and special projects as needed.


Manages multiple demands to achieve optimal efficiency and productivity while ensuring business deadlines and requirements are met.


Performs Internal controls assessments of acquired companies and leads efforts to mitigate identified control deficiencies.


Participates in critical business and technology initiatives and projects, ensuring that audit’s perspective is effectively voiced and appropriate controls are designed and implemented.


Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state, and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE 


Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, in a relevant field, preferably Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration, required


Three (3) or more years of related experience in internal audit or external audit in the insurance industry, required


Understanding of the insurance industry, required


Certified Public Accountant (CPA), a plus


CIA - Certified Internal Auditor, a plus


Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), a plus



SKILLS


Must have a comprehensive understanding of the Global Internal Audit Standards, procedures, and methodology


Proven multitasking skills, ability to manage multiple audits and projects at the same time


Ability to work independently and effectively monitor own performance to ensure plans, schedules, and budgets are met


Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills are essential


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


Effective working knowledge of Excel, Microsoft Word and PowerPoint


Knowledge of audit data extraction and analysis (or interest to develop knowledge) is strongly preferred


Exhibits strong drive for results and success; conveys a sense of urgency to achieve outcomes and exceed expectations


Excellent written, oral, and presentation skills


Commitment to compliance and accountability

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting (Hybrid)
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Leads the end-to-end accounting and reporting function for producer commission activity. Oversees daily accounting operations, the preparation of financial information, and monthly close and reporting deadlines, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Alliant's financial results. Working closely with Divisional Controllers, Producers, Sales leaders, and Legal, this role ensures contracts are interpreted and applied appropriately and commissions are calculated accurately. Ensures the team follows Alliant policies and procedures while adapting processes to support growth, and is responsible for staff supervision, performance reviews, development, and training.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Own the monthly (and any interim) producer commission calculation process from data intake through final payment file.

Prepare and distribute commission statements/calculations directly to producers, fielding and resolving questions.

Maintain and update commission calculation models, schedules, and tools to reflect current contract terms.

Review new, amended, and acquired producer contracts to ensure commission terms are accurately reflected in calculation logic and systems.

Work with Legal to resolve contract interpretation questions, disputes, and amendments affecting commissions.

Analyze commission expense trends and reasonableness, including production levels, rates, and payouts; investigate and resolve variances.

Develop and maintain review procedures and supporting documentation that meet audit and internal control requirements.

Reconcile commission accruals and payables each month.

Identify, develop, and implement process improvements and automation opportunities in commission workflows and accounting operations.

Oversee the maintenance and development of financial reporting and month-end close processes.

Support monthly financial statement close and maintain related schedules.

Prepare monthly commission reporting and analysis for the Divisional Controller and senior finance leaders, including variance commentary.

Lead commission integration activities related to acquisitions.

Review acquired producer contracts and payment schedules, along with legacy calculation methods while maintaining controls and payment continuity.

Support internal and external audit requests related to commission accounting.

Collaborate with internal partners to address accounting, reporting, and operational needs.

Manage the Accounting team’s daily activities and ensure deadlines are met.

Manage staff by motivating/mentoring staff, providing employee training and development, conducting performance reviews, and performing disciplinary action as appropriate.

Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.

Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS 
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE


Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance; or an equivalent combination of education and experience  


Seven (7) or more years of progressive accounting experience    

Insurance, financial services, or producer/broker-based industry experience 

Experience with commissions, incentive compensation, or sales compensation accounting    

Experience reviewing and interpreting contracts or commission agreements  

Experience working in a rapidly growing organization and improving processes to support scale and efficiency    



SKILLS


Solid understanding of GAAP

Proficient with Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem solving skills

Demonstrated team management and mentoring skills and the ability to keep staff focused, accountable, and on track

Excellent communication skills and able to communicate directly with leadership

Ability to manage competing monthly deadlines

Ability to explain calculations clearly to producers and outside brokers and collaborate with Legal and Controllership



#LI-DR2

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 


Responsible for collaborating with Consultants, Account Directors, Account Associates and Underwriting to research, analyze and develop appropriate recommendations for Alliant's clients' group benefit programs.  As part of the team, advises clients on group benefit plan strategy and competitive bidding process.  Manages the competitive bidding process for client RFPs.  Negotiates plan design features and prices with carriers and vendors on behalf of Alliant's clients. 



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Researches the health and welfare carrier/vendor insurance marketplace to identify competitive plan options and service providers for clients and prospective clients;

Develops group benefit program marketing strategies in collaboration with Consultants and Account Director for  clients;

Develops group benefit program RFPs for clients that are consistent with client’s employee benefits objectives and strategy;

Creates group benefit program proposals; reviews with vendors (for accuracy) on behalf of clients;

Solicits bids (market research) for clients from carriers and vendors;

Monitors receipt of bids to ensure that the quotes are timely and are to specification;

Analyzes quotes and identifies competitive alternatives;

In collaboration with the Account Director, Consultant and Underwriter, selects which quotes to recommend to clients;

Advises clients (directly or through the Account Director and/or Consultant) as to modifications of RFPs and other strategic alternatives in response to cost or plan design concerns raised by bid responses;

Directly negotiates competitive rates and plan design alternatives to the respective Account Director and Consultant;

Participates in client presentations and meetings; counsels and advises clients on strategic alternatives;

Reviews peers’ proposals for accuracy, completeness and creative problem solving;

Collaborates with appropriate personnel to design tools and processes to promote timely and effective communication of benefits information to Alliant’s clients and prospective clients;

Responsible for serving as the primary operational liaison between company, independent insurance producers, employer groups, and carrier partners. SUMMARY 


Responsible for evaluating and underwriting submissions for all pricing requests, including advanced underwriting and analysis projects.  Leads and/or assists in the management and execution of all assigned client projects. 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  


Competent in all major areas of general underwriting including, but not limited to, pricing forecasts for medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, life and AD&D, disability and EAP pricing for both rate development as well as option pricing;

Competent in special pricing and marketing projects such as:  medical network changes, claim re-pricing, disruption analysis, migration analysis, insured to self-funded modeling, contribution structure change modeling, as well as others;

Meets with Producers, clients, Underwriters, Account Executives and Benefits Analysts as needed to define and accomplish projects;

Expert in understanding actuarial plan values and how they are used in various pricing and analysis projects.  This includes ability to competently use software available for such types of plan analysis and pricing;

Full understanding of underwriting models and reporting templates, with ability to fully modify and customize to meet customer needs;

Works with internal staff and vendors to establish project timelines, identifies critical deadlines for completion and performs necessary functions to ensure project completion;

Assists or leads all assigned client underwriting projects, including the ability to present analysis to clients directly in a confident and easy-to-understand manner;

Maintains data tracking and reporting for financial management, underwriting models, client reports and other analytical reporting deliverables;

Assists with the development of new reporting tools and models;

Competent in multiple carrier data and reporting systems as needed to obtain claim data for reporting and analysis purposes;

Confidently analyzes and challenges insurance company renewal calculations for fully-insured contracts (Health, Dental and Vision);

Maintains files and historical data on all assigned clients and/or programs;

Actively engages in educational opportunities to further underwriting knowledge, market trends and regulatory environment;

Responsible for accuracy and timeliness of all work performed, including proper management of timelines and meeting deadlines as established;

Addresses incoming correspondence and responds as required in a timely manner;

jobs.title: Claims Adjuster - Professional Liability
jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY 

Responsible for handling high exposure professional liability and litigated claims, as well as commercial injury and non-injury general liability and automobile claims, in accordance with client, carrier and company guidelines, statutory regulations and best practices. Primary duties include investigating, evaluating, reporting to authorities as applicable, and maintaining adequate reserves. Manages claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES  

Maintains diary system to ensure claim files are up to date, and that required follow-up is taking place;

Investigates and evaluates claims to determine liability and compensability;

Communicates with vendors, producers, policy holders, clients and insurance companies to communicate claim status;

Negotiates settlements with claimants and insureds;

Reports to authorities as applicable, providing updates on litigated claims, serious injuries, and claims over the adjuster’s authorization limits;

Sets and manages reserve accounts, and ensures that adequate levels are maintained;

Analyzes and reviews invoices for payment;

Provides producer inquiry assistance;

Provides set-up of rental vehicles for clients as needed;

Creates and maintains reports and worksheets as needed;

Provides training and mentoring to less experienced adjusters;

Travels as necessary to attend appeal hearings, trials, and perform on-site investigations;

May act as backup for Supervisor on an as needed basis;

Complies with agency management system data standards and data integrity (enters and maintains complete and accurate information);

Other duties as assigned.

High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

Responsible for attending continuing education as

Seven (7) or more years experience in liability claims processing

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including telephone and listening skills

Excellent customer service skills

Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

Strong analytical skills and problem solving skills

Strong organizational and time management skills

Discretion and independent judgment required

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite - Excel, Word, Outlook

jobs.description_html:
SUMMARY

Responsible for providing a wide variety of support services to promote the company's product portfolio and develop and support the Marketing Department to increase company revenue and profit; and has a leadership role with less experienced marketers and carrier relations; and participates in setting the strategic direction of the department and represents the company professionally at outside events.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Agent Support Functions:  Promote the company’s product portfolio at a “proficient” level to qualify for the Senior Marketing Consultant position within product area and the ability to cross-sell, educate and promote all company products and services. Have proven ability to operate at an expert level when working with the technology required to produce at a high level. This includes, but is not limited to the software, hardware, tools, websites and web-based programs that the company utilizes to execute this position.

Team Roster:  Develop assigned marketing plans and provide service assistance to agents; Handle 50–100 telephone calls per day with  agencies and agents on all aspects of assigned products; Recruit, train, service and assist agents to enable agents to produce at highest level possible; Assist agents with issues including recruit kits for carriers, training, contracting, certification, transactional issues such as electronic signature, telephonic signatures and app-by-email; Communicate with agents regularly regarding product information, rate changes and key agent benefits; Monitor compliance with program reporting rules and sales requirements; Provide technical support training, sales and marketing coaching; Identify and cultivate top producers; Identify problem agents; Recruit agents to participate in special opportunities, such as new lead sources, alternative methods of enrollment (e-commerce, e-signature, tele-app., etc.). Develop a Team Roster of agents/agencies and maintain regular contact/support. Manage Team Roster and excel in managing book of business.  Show a proven pattern of managing complex relationships and the ability to support/educate/establish credibility with biggest producers.   It may also require the ability to help train the field, as well as internal employees, on compliance and suitability requirements to do business with certain carriers. Normally there should be no communication directly with the end consumer; all communications with the end consumer should be made by and through the Agent. There can be exceptions to this rule based on specific circumstances and requests. For example, a marketer cannot participate in the closing of a sale or make recommendations. However, it may be possible to lend support regarding specific product information. This needs to be reviewed and approved by a marketing supervisor prior to the conversation taking place.

Leadership Responsibilities:  Demonstrated expertise in all aspects of the job including task management, carrier knowledge, technology, problem solving, negotiating and marketing strategies.  Represents company at carrier meetings, teleconferences and has authority to contact selected carrier reps to resolve problem situations.  Serves as a resource for newer marketers in mastering the role.  Follows all company procedures and fully capable to manage the most sensitive relationships.  Develops strong relationships between departments and communicates effectively in writing, phone and stand-up presentations.  Has assigned regional responsibilities for carriers that are managed regionally.  Regularly leads discussions at Department marketing meetings and is respected by peers, carriers and producers.

Department Support Functions:  Update and maintain system information in accordance with policies and procedures; Manage Team Roster; Update and maintain task list.  Have working knowledge of Who Quit Writing, Debit Balances, MGA reports, lead distribution/lead management, incomplete contracts, certification process, moving agents and agencies into production, able to conduct webinars and display/introduce SMS technology tools. Ability to conduct agent webinars, product introductions, special projects and prepare information for internal marketing meetings.  Assist with training of new employees.   Ability to travel on behalf of the company to attend meetings.


QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE

High School Diploma or GED

Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

Five (5) or more years of General Insurance Industry or related field (financial Services, marketing, web-based business,  business-to-business customer service or call center

Valid Life/Health Insurance License within 90 Days


SKILLS

Enhanced knowledge of insurance services industries and specific current knowledge of product lines assigned to the marketer.

Fully proficient in SMS products, technology and services.

Highly experienced in working effectively with inbound and outbound callers/ customers.

Proficient at negotiating and problem solving to resolve internal and external conflicts.

Proven skill in initiating change needed to help Department improve processes and achieve business goals.

Proven skill in the use of office equipment including computer, fax, printer, telephone system, etc.

Proficient in the use of time management and organization skills and leads by example in terms of documentation, Contact Manager usage, etc.

Experience in maintaining effective working relationships with all customers, employees and the general public.  Maintains confidentiality of discussions including SMS business strategy, carrier data, employee personal information; and any Nondisclosure Agreements that are entered into by the Company.

Excels in project management.

Proficient computer skills (Microsoft/Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, MS Outlook software preferred) including conducting effective webinars with producers.

Proven ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, in a constructive manner and properly document information such as contracts sent, conversations with agents and agent or company commitments in the Contact Manager.

Proven ability to approach and communicate with a wide range of personalities in a professional and courteous manner.

Proven ability to engage in effective interpersonal interaction, verbal communication and written communication.

Proven ability to persuade.

Successfully able to maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail while remaining flexible and responsive when faced with multiple urgent requests.

Proven ability to read, write and communicate English effectively and articulately.

Proven ability to maintain all company policies, including all confidentiality and safety policies.

Effectively and actively contribute to team effort.

Proven ability to work independently, exercise independent judgment, make and execute decisions.

Proven ability to be a self-starter motivated and accomplish goals and tasks within a given time frame.
